title: IT Specialist and IT QA Specialist
description:
IT SPECIALIST



The IT Specialist is a strategic position that plays a pivotal role in the data integrity of key My Amazon Guy functions. The position is responsible for assisting the CTO and IT Department, maintaining and enhancing dashboards, data models, and data pipelines. Possess advanced analytical and decision-making skills. The role requires someone who is passionate about data quality, data analytics, and automation in order to drive business strategy.



An ability to be an expert in problem-solving, critical thinking, and an understanding of complex system dependencies are essential in enabling the IT Manager to show where My Amazon Guy processes are broken and how those processes are affecting key data points. An individual with a strong passion to solve problems and improve data integrity will excel in this position.



Key Responsibilities:

• Manage and maintain company IT systems, ensuring optimal performance, reliability, and security across all platforms.

• Provide technical support and troubleshooting for software, and network-related issues across teams.

• Ensure implementation and compliance with security systems, including antivirus, firewalls, and two-factor authentication.

• Oversee and optimize the use of company tools (e.g., Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Asana, Slack, Monday, HubSpot, WordPress).

• Support website management and CMS platforms, ensuring functionality, updates, and performance optimization.

• Analyze system data and create reports, dashboards, and visualizations to support decision-making.

• Collaborate cross-functionally to understand workflows and improve system integrations and data architecture.

• Assist in automation and process improvements, including API integrations and workflow optimization where applicable.

• Document IT processes, provide training, and ensure teams are equipped to use systems efficiently.

• Proactively identify technical issues, recommend solutions, and implement improvements to enhance operational efficiency and quality output.



Qualifications:

• 1+ years of experience in an IT Help Desk role

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Ability to multitask and prioritize

• Experience with

• Data Analytics

• Jotform

• Airtable

• Zapier

• Hubspot

• Asana

• Google Workspace

• Database management is a plus but not required

• JavaScript, Python, CSS, HTML is a plus but not required

• Proficient with Microsoft Office, G Suite applications, and computer security systems

• Proficient with, or able to quickly become proficient with, a range of general and specialized applications, software, and hardware used in the organization and the industry.

• Expert in problem-solving, critical thinking, and an understanding of complex system dependencies



--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



IT QA SPECIALIST



The IT Quality Assurance role has ended up being 99% focused on Quality Assurance (QA) rather than audits. It is responsible for ensuring that IT systems and processes are consistently monitored and improved in alignment with MAG’s standards and industry regulations. Responsibilities include performing detailed tests to identify and resolve system bugs, developing and maintaining automated test scripts, and providing expert and technical audits.



An ability to be an expert in problem-solving, critical thinking, and an understanding of complex system dependencies are essential in enabling the IT Manager to show where My Amazon Guy processes are broken and how those processes are affecting key data points. An individual with a strong passion to solve problems and improve data integrity will excel in this position.



Key Responsibilities:

• Ensure proper prioritization of tasks is observed, and assignments are properly actioned and handled per MAG standards.

• Proactively contribute to providing strategies for work quality advancements.

• Collaborate with IT Devs to ensure testing and observation of solutions add value to end users.

• Ensure all fields in tasks have met the standard requirement of the team.

• Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on complex system issues.

• Act as a Cross-Departmental Unblocker by managing tasks such as workflow automations.

• Create templates and initiatives to improve QA process efficiency across the organization.

• Coordinate and generate independent test cases for each newly developed application/system.

• Manage QA IT projects during each phase, ensuring all tasks are reviewed for quality assurance.

• Communicate and recommend improvements to the functionality, design, and usability of new systems/applications.

• Ensure all work projects are compliant with the company’s standards.

• Serve as the final line of defense to ensure IT solutions meet end users’ requests.



Qualifications:

• At least 3 years of relevant experience in IT quality assurance and audit roles.

• Strong understanding of quality assurance principles, methodologies, and best practices.

• Hands-on experience with No-Code/Low-Code platforms, such as Zapier, Google Workspace, JotForms, HubSpot, PandaDoc, and AirTable.

• Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, and API integration.

• Experience with Asana or similar project management tools for task and project tracking.

• Familiarity with software testing techniques, tools, and defect-tracking systems.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

• Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team environment.



What We Offer:

• Competitive salary base

• Permanent remote setup

• Unlimited free access to MAG School courses and SOP Library

• Opportunities for professional development and career advancement

title: DTC Video Editor
description:
As a DTC Video Editor, you will be responsible for transforming raw footage, UGC submissions, brand assets, and scripts into high-impact, conversion-focused ads for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Google,
 campaigns, and website placements.



This role requires a powerful blend of storytelling, design, and performance marketing, ensuring every asset you produce is optimized to stop the scroll, drive engagement, and convert.



You will collaborate closely with DTC Strategists, UGC Creators, Designers, Paid Media Specialists, and Project Managers to deliver high-volume creative on tight deadlines.



Key Responsibilities

• Video Editing & Creative Production: Edit high-performing video ads for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Google, and other channels; create variations for A/B testing; incorporate motion graphics, sound design, captions, and brand elements; reformat content for different aspect ratios; edit UGC, product demos, and testimonials; and optimize assets for platform requirements.

• Creative Strategy & Collaboration: Collaborate with DTC Strategists, UGC creators, and internal teams to develop polished ads based on creative briefs, storyboards, marketing insights, and brand guidelines.

• Performance Optimization: Apply performance insights and creative learnings to improve hooks, pacing, and conversions; rapidly produce test-ready variations; and use modular templates for efficient, consistent output.

• Project & File Management: Manage multiple clients, deadlines, revisions, and creative requests; maintain organized files and naming conventions; upload final assets to client drives; and track deliverables and communicate updates using tools like Airtable, Asana, or Notion.



Qualifications

• Proven experience as a Video Editor with strong performance-ad portfolio (Meta/TikTok/YT).

• Proficiency in editing tools: Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, Final Cut Pro, etc.

• Experience in creating DTC, UGC, or e-commerce-focused video ads.

• Ability to understand marketing metrics and translate them into creative decisions.

• Skilled in typography, motion graphics, color grading, pacing, and sound design.

• Knowledge of Airtable, Asana, or Notion for project management.

• Strong communication, adaptability, and team collaboration.

• Thrives in high-pressure, high-output creative environments.



What We Offer:

• Competitive salary base

• Permanent WFH setup

• Unlimited FREE access to MAG School courses and SOP Library!

• Work schedule is in EST (Monday-Friday only)

title: Estimator
description:
Salson Projects is an owner-operated Brisbane commercial fitout and joinery company. We specialise in medical and healthcare fitouts, including radiology, CT/MRI shielding, medical centres, GP, dental and allied health. We are known for clinical compliance expertise (ARPANSA, infection control) and Brisbane-manufactured joinery.



The Role

You will support the tendering and delivery of Salson Projects work by providing accurate, timely and well-organised estimating and tender preparation. You will review tender documentation, complete quantity take-offs, obtain and analyse supplier and subcontractor pricing, prepare cost estimates and assist with tender submissions. You will work closely with the Director and project team to make sure estimates reflect the full scope, clinical compliance requirements and current market pricing, while protecting our margin targets.



Key Responsibilities



 • Review tender invitations, drawings, specifications, schedules and scopes of work

 • Complete accurate quantity take-offs from drawings and specifications

 • Identify suppliers and subcontractors for each package and issue requests for quotation

 • Review quotations against tender scope to identify exclusions, qualifications and gaps

 • Prepare detailed estimates covering labour, materials, joinery, plant, subcontractors and preliminaries

 • Price specialist medical scope, including radiation shielding and infection-control requirements

 • Assist with tender schedules, pricing schedules and other commercial submission requirements

 • Maintain organised electronic tender and estimating files

 • Identify discrepancies, missing information, ambiguous scope and commercial or delivery risks

 • Maintain estimating templates, pricing data and historical cost data

 • Hand over awarded tender information to the project team



About You



 • Experience in construction estimating, quantity take-offs, contract administration, project administration or a related construction role

 • Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications and scopes of work

 • Experience completing or assisting with quantity take-offs

 • Strong numerical ability and attention to detail

 • Strong Microsoft Excel skills

 • Experience with estimating, take-off or project software highly regarded

 • Good understanding of construction materials, trades and sequencing

 • Commercial fitout, joinery or healthcare construction experience highly regarded

 • Strong organisation and time management; able to manage multiple tender deadlines

 • Strong written and verbal communication

 • Reliable internet and a self-managed home workspace

title: Supply Chain Manager (E-commerce, Remote)
description:
We run a group of fast-growing online stores selling to customers in Europe, Canada and Australia. We're looking for a Supply Chain Manager to keep our products in stock, our suppliers on track and our refunds low.



What you'll do:

- Manage daily communication with our sourcing agents and suppliers in China (ServicePoints, HST, ShipGoods)

- Handle out-of-stock orders: find the same or a similar product, check other suppliers, and source from AliExpress when needed

- Follow up on delayed shipments, address errors and lost parcels, and file supplier claims

- Track problem products (high refunds, quality issues) and d
 with the team to fix or remove them

- Keep supplier quotes, prices and margins up to date

- Think proactively and suggest improvements to our supply chain operations

- Work closely with our customer service team so customers get fast, correct updates



What we're looking for:

- 2+ years in e-commerce supply chain, dropshipping or purchasing

- Experience working with Chinese suppliers or sourcing agents

- Strong English, clear and fast communication

- Organized: you follow up without being chased

- Comfortable with Shopify, Google Sheets and Slack

- Bonus: experience with AliExpress, 1688 or DSers



Details:

- Remote, 15-20 hours per week to start, with a path to full-time

- $5/hour depending on experience, paid every two weeks

- Hours tracked in Hubstaff

- Start: as soon as possible



To apply: send a short message about your supply chain experience, the suppliers or tools you've worked with, and one example of a supplier problem you solved. Applications without this won't be reviewed.

title: Full-Time Cold Caller / Inside Sales VA
description:
Hours: Full-Time | 8 hours daily (9:00 PM – 5:00 AM PHT)

Base Salary: $4.00/hour

Commissions: $15.00 bonus per closed deal (Expectation: 5–10+ closed deals/month)*

Start Date: Immediately



"Commission is paid at $15 per closed deal. If 10 or more deals close within a single calendar month, the rate for all deals closed in that month increases to $20 per deal."





About the Role:

We are looking for an energetic, resilient, and enthusiastic Cold Caller to join our growing team. We do not need the most experienced caller—we want someone with great energy who is hungry to learn! We will supply full training on our process and systems. Your main goal is to pick up the phone, follow our script, read social cues, and build genuine rapport with prospects to let them know you are listening.



Key Responsibilities:

• High-Volume Calling: Handle 200+ calls daily using a fast, easy-to-use power dialer.

• Rapport Building: Listen carefully to social cues and have real, genuine conversations rather than sounding like a robot.

•  Actively Listen and reiterate questions to confirm you understand and ask great follow up questions

• Script & Process Compliance: Closely follow our script and training guidelines to qualify prospects.

• Multi-Tasking & Logging: Maintain high responsiveness on Microsoft Teams while taking clear notes inside the system during your live calls.

Required Qualifications:

• Thick Skin: Rejection is a massive part of the job. You must be able to handle "no" professionally and understand that it is never personal.

• High Enthusiasm & Coachability: A strong willingness to learn, adapt, and implement the constructive feedback we provide during training.

• Technical Setup: A stable internet connection, a high-quality noise-canceling headset, and a computer capable of running our power dialer and Microsoft Teams seamlessly.



Compensation & Financial Growth



We want you to grow as our business grows. Here is a realistic breakdown of what you can expect to earn based on your performance:





Payment Type Earnings Breakdown Estimated Monthly Total

Base Pay Only $4.00/hour × 40 hours/week ~$693.00

Target Performance Base Pay + 5 Closed Deals ($75 bonus) ~$768.00

High Performance Base Pay + 10 Closed Deals ($200 bonus) ~$893.00

Retroactive Tier Blast Base Pay + 11+ Closed Deals (Retroactive bump applied) $913.00+





Note: Monthly estimates are calculated on an average of 40 hour work weeks

Room to Grow:

There is no cap on your bonuses. If you consistently hit or exceed the 10+ closed deals mark, we will review your performance for a baseline hourly rate increase and unlocked tier-based commission structures.

title: CPA / Financial Advisor
description:
Hours: Approximately 5–10 hours per week to start  

Compensation: Based on experience





We are looking for an experienced, U.S.-licensed CPA to help manage and improve the financial health of our growing business.



We need someone who can do more than prepare taxes or review numbers. We're looking for a financial partner who can help us stay organized, save money on taxes, manage cash flow and make smart financial decisions as we grow.



What You'll Be Doing



Tax Planning & Review



- Review previous business and personal tax returns to identify possible errors, missed deductions, or opportunities to reduce tax liabilities.

- Recommend amended tax returns when appropriate.

- Review existing IRS tax debt and identify possible ways to reduce penalties or improve payment arrangements.

- Develop strategies to legally minimize future business and personal taxes.

- Provide guidance on S-Corp payroll, owner distributions, and retirement contributions.

- Assist with federal and New York State tax planning and compliance.



Financial Management



- Review bookkeeping and make sure financial records are accurate and organized.

- Prepare monthly financial reports showing revenue, expenses, and profit.

- Monitor cash flow and help establish budgets.

- Recommend how much money should be set aside for taxes, savings, and business expenses.

- Help determine how much the business owner can safely pay themselves.



Business Growth & Planning



- Review business expenses and identify ways to improve profitability.

- Help create financial goals and plans for business growth.

- Provide guidance on hiring, business investments, and expansion.

- Help manage business debt and improve financial stability.

- Meet with the business owner monthly to review finances and make recommendations.



What We're Looking For



- Active U.S. CPA license (required).

- At least 5 years of experience working with U.S. small businesses.

- Strong knowledge of S-Corporation taxes and financial management.

- Experience reviewing and amending previous tax returns.

- Experience with IRS tax debt, payment plans and penalty relief.

- Familiarity with New York State business taxes.

- Experience with QuickBooks, Excel, or similar accounting software.

- Strong communication skills and the ability to explain financial information in simple terms.

- Someone who is organized, proactive, trustworthy and comfortable working independently.





We want someone who will help us:



- Have a clear understanding of our business finances every month.

- Identify legitimate opportunities to reduce existing and future tax liabilities.

- Improve cash flow and profitability.

- Make informed decisions about owner pay, savings and business growth.

- Build strong financial systems as the business continues to expand.



Initial responsibilities will include a review of prior tax returns and current financial systems. Additional fees for amended returns or specialized tax services can be discussed separately.



How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your resume and U.S. CPA license information.

2. A brief description of your experience with S-Corporations, tax planning and IRS tax matters.

3. Your hourly rate or proposed monthly retainer.

4. Your availability.

5. A brief explanation of how you would approach reviewing our finances and prior tax returns.



Please note: An active U.S. CPA license is required for this position.

title: DeFi Partnerships Manager: Run the Reps, Book the Calls, Earn Uncapped Overrides
description:
Part-time: 20 hrs/week | $10/hr base + $100 per appointment you book + overrides and deal bonuses, no cap | Remote | Crypto/DeFi



At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month from base and appointment bonuses alone, before any partnership revenue, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗚𝗠𝗜



GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).



LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.



Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.



We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲



One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2 personally booked, target 5 team total, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.



If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show.



Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲 𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.



𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝟯𝟬 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀 (𝗽𝗮𝗶𝗱 𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗹)



Week 1: full audit of every rep and the current pipeline, clean pipeline and reporting live, personal outreach started.

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Zero held by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review.

Day 30: 2+ qualified appointments held per week pace, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 3+/week.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week



Minimum Requirement: 2 qualified appointments held per week that you personally booked. Your base pay covers these first two. Every additional personally booked appointment pays $100, and every rep-booked appointment pays you the $30 override, starting from the first. The 30-day trial milestones above set the ramp: 2+ held by Day 14, 2+/week pace by Day 30.



$100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked beyond your weekly minimum of 2

$30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked



𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘂𝗲, 𝘁𝘄𝗼 𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗲𝘀:



Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep package.



- Commission: 20% of all upgrade fees generated by the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- No ceiling on either.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝘀 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲 𝗼𝗻 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽:



- Mints $100,000 and generates $15,000 in upgrade fees: $3,000 + $3,000 = $6,000

- Mints $200,000 and generates $30,000 in upgrade fees: $6,000 + $6,000 = $12,000



Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn a 20% override on everything the rep earns from that partnership, both their 20% commission on upgrade fees and their 3% launch bonus, for the same 180-day window. Paid by GMI on top of their earnings, never deducted from them.



Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.



Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships.



No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both).



Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard.



Base and appointment bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and $GMI, with the GMI portion on an 18-month vesting schedule. Commission are paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.



𝗥𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀



- Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

- Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

- Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

- Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

- Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

- 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

- Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call



𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗮𝗿𝗱𝘀



Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.



𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝘁𝗼 𝗮𝗽𝗽𝗹𝘆



Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. IMPORTANT: Your subject line must start with BOND OPS.

2. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

3. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

4. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

5. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

6. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.

description:
JustInsurance is hiring a full-time Customer Service Specialist who communicates clearly, solves problems, and follows through until the customer’s issue is resolved.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Support customers through phone calls,
, and text messages.

• Sound judgment, organized follow-through, and the ability to work independently within clear authority.

• Reliable internet, a suitable computer and headset, and a quiet environment for customer calls.



WHAT OWNERSHIP MEANS HERE

We value people who investigate, act within their authority, verify the fix, and help prevent recurrence. When approval or specialist help is needed, bring evidence and a recommendation, keep the customer informed, and follow through. Never invent a resolution or make unauthorized account or payment changes.



HOW TO APPLY

Send your resume and concise answers to these questions:

1. Describe a customer issue you personally resolved. What caused it, what did you do, how did you verify the result, and what did you change to prevent recurrence?

5. Confirm that US $6/hour and 40 hours/week work for you. State your available working hours and time zone.



SELECTION PROCESS

Applicants may be invited to a short exercise using fictional customer cases, a GHL task or walkthrough, and a live phone role-play and follow-up discussion. title: Experienced SEO Specialist - ₱79,000/month ($1,250 USD) - Remote Full-Time
description:
PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



Many applicants have missed the How to Apply instructions and submitted applications without the required SEO results or without
ing us. Please read the requirements below before you apply.



Our preferred way to apply is to
 Mark directly at 
 with your resume and BOTH of the following:

2. For EACH website you submit, a list of at least 15–20 keywords you personally helped rank within the top 3 organic positions on Google. Identify the website and the approximate ranking period for each list.



We are a private equity-backed organization managing 30+ businesses across healthcare, construction, real estate, consulting, and other industries. Our Philippine-based team includes more than 25 skilled professionals across SEO, content, web development, and digital marketing. We are now looking for an experienced SEO Specialist who can take full ownership of a portfolio of websites and drive measurable growth in organic rankings, traffic, leads, and conversions. Your primary objective will be to help established and newly launched websites rank within the top 3 positions in Google.

This is not a basic SEO role. We need someone who can develop the strategy, determine what needs to be done, execute at a high level, and take responsibility for the results.



MAIN REQUIREMENTS



1. Strong Content Marketing Skills



We believe that high-quality content accounts for a significant portion of SEO success. The right candidate must understand how to plan and create content that satisfies search intent, demonstrates genuine expertise, and performs well in both Google Search and AI-powered search engines. You do not need to be a full-time writer, and you will have access to our in-house content team. 



We are not looking for someone who simply assigns keywords to writers. You must be capable of directing the complete content strategy and ensuring that every page has a clear purpose and a realistic opportunity to rank.



2. Proven Top 3 Position in Google



You must provide verifiable evidence that you have personally helped websites rank within the top 3 organic Google positions for at least 15–20 meaningful and competitive keywords. We regularly receive applications from candidates who can discuss SEO concepts but cannot demonstrate significant ranking results. For this role, actual results are essential.



Your evidence should include:

• Google Search Console screenshots showing improvements in clicks and impressions

• A list of websites you directly optimized

• At least 15–20 keywords that reached Google’s top three organic positions

• The approximate ranking period or timeline

• Your specific responsibilities and the actions you personally implemented

• Supporting screenshots or third-party ranking reports, when available



Important Disclaimer Regarding Results:



The results you submit must be primarily attributable to your own strategy and execution. Please do not present the overall success of a large SEO team if you were only a minor contributor or handled a limited portion of the work.



3. Strong Analytical and Problem-Solving Ability



SEO presents different challenges, and the same strategy will not work in every situation. We need someone who can diagnose problems, identify likely causes, prioritize the right actions, and adjust the strategy based on evidence.

We are not looking for someone who relies on generic SEO checklists. You must be able to investigate each situation using data, form a clear diagnosis, recommend a practical solution, and measure whether your strategy is working.



4. Ownership and Ability to Work Independently



We do not want to micromanage the person in this role. You will be given clear business objectives, target websites, and performance expectations. We are looking for a mature, proactive professional who can work with minimal supervision, take responsibility for decisions, communicate problems early, and remain accountable for results.

If progress slows down, you should investigate why and recommend the next course of action - not wait for someone to tell you what to do.



WHY WORK WITH US?



1. Above-Average Compensation



Earn approximately ₱79,000 per month ($1,250 USD), with opportunities for compensation increases as you deliver measurable results and create greater value for the business.



2. Career Growth



High performers can qualify for faster promotions, salary increases, bonuses, and performance-based incentives. We reward people who consistently create meaningful business impact.



3. Exposure to 27 Businesses



Work across companies in healthcare, construction, real estate, consulting, and other industries. This provides a breadth of SEO and business experience that few professionals have the opportunity to develop.



4. Experienced Digital Leadership



Work alongside leaders with extensive experience in SEO, paid advertising, conversion rate optimization, digital marketing, and business growth.



5. Strong Internal Support



You will have access to in-house writers, developers, and other digital specialists. Although you will own the SEO strategy, you will not be expected to execute every supporting task alone.



6. Fully Remote



Work from anywhere in the Philippines, provided you have a reliable internet connection and can collaborate effectively with our international team.



HOW TO APPLY



 your application to 
 



Please include all of the following:



1. Your updated resume



2.Google Search Console screenshots for the websites you personally optimized, showing graph in organic clicks and impressions



3. For each website you optimized in the past, give a list of at least 15–20 keywords you personally helped rank within the top 3 organic positions on Google



Please do not submit results that primarily came from the work of a larger team unless you clearly disclose your individual contribution.



Applications without verifiable SEO results may not be considered.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a practical SEO assessment before proceeding to the interview stage.

title: Creative Digital ARTIST
description:
Digital Artist Wanted — Realistic Fantasy Lioness, Jewelled Crown & Flames | US$100



We’re seeking a skilled digital artist to create a signature character for an inspirational brand about courage, inner strength and moving forward.



The vision



A soft, feminine lioness face with the magnificent, flowing mane of a male lion—powerful yet gentle, regal, brave and magical, with realistic feline features rather than a cartoon appearance.



She needs:



A softly shaped face in warm champagne, ivory and gold, with natural shading.



A luxurious, windswept mane and clearly visible ears.



Amber-gold eyes with visible pupils and a fiery glow contained inside the eyes.



An intricate gold crown with elegant branching points, a striking central jewel and sparkling jewel details.



Convincing golden flames and fine fire embers around the crown and outer mane—no paint splashes, glitter effects or shooting stars.



No feathered wings.



Artwork required



Keep the same character, colouring and crown consistent across these views and poses:



Front-facing portrait.



Side-facing portrait.



Lounging on a textured black-and-gold rock, with her head resting sideways on her paws.



Standing tall, with her full body and tail visible.



Prancing towards the viewer while roaring.



Rear view, as though walking away.



Provide matching versions with and without flames. Supply the lion, crown, flames/embers and rock as separate reusable elements, as well as complete compositions, so we can reposition them or use them independently.



Files and references



High-resolution JPGs and transparent PNGs.



Black-background versions with generous space around every complete pose; no cropped crown, mane, paws or tail.



Editable, layered source files with the reusable elements separated.



A simple front, side and back character reference sheet.



Separate front and side crown references showing its structure and jewel placement.



Two rounds of revisions.



The lion will eventually become a stuffed toy, and the crown a glistening, bejewelled wearable crown. Designs must be clear enough for future makers to interpret. Physical production, sewing patterns and engineering are outside this job.



Animation — additional quote



We also want a short animation of this same lion roaring. Please quote separately, state whether sound is included, and provide relevant animation samples. Further animation may be negotiated.



Private references



We have an existing reference image, but substantial changes are required. We will privately share the image, brand identity and detailed changes with a shortlisted artist after initial agreement on price and requirements. Review these and confirm the full scope before starting. Keep all supplied material confidential.



Ownership



Upon full payment, you must agree in writing to assign all transferable intellectual property rights in your original contributions to us, worldwide for their full duration, including commercial use, modification, reproduction, licensing and product manufacture, without further fees or royalties.



Disclose any AI, stock or third-party materials and restrictions before starting. Do not use anything that prevents the agreed ownership or uses. No resale, reuse, sharing or portfolio publication of our references or completed designs without written permission. Any reference permissions must be resolved before work begins.



Budget: US$100 total for the static artwork



Includes all listed static artwork, files and two revision rounds. Animation is separately negotiated. Flag scope concerns upfront; no additional charges without written agreement.



To apply, include:



Your portfolio link and three relevant existing samples—not only logos—showing realistic animals, fur, fantasy artwork, crowns/jewellery or flames. Explain your contribution.



A brief approach, tools used and whether you use AI.



Turnaround time and proposed final image dimensions.



Confirmation that you accept the static-artwork scope, US$100 budget, revisions, confidentiality and ownership terms.



A separate animation quote, if offered.



Existing samples are sufficient; no unpaid custom sample is required.

title: AI Solutions Engineer – Software, Systems & AI Automation
description:
JOB TITLE: AI Solutions Engineer – Software, Systems & AI Automation

COMPANY: Ashlex LLC

LOCATION: Philippines (Remote)

TYPE: Part-time initially, with long-term / full-time potential

EXPERIENCE: Strong mid-level technical generalist or above

COMPENSATION: Negotiable, based on experience and demonstrated ability



ABOUT ASHLEX



Ashlex is a US-based company providing technology consulting, custom software development, hosting, business management, and business process outsourcing (BPO) services. We develop applications and internal tools, integrate commercial software, maintain infrastructure, and support clients in different industries.



We actively use AI tools including Codex, ChatGPT, and other LLMs to help us develop solutions faster and work more effectively.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We're looking for a technically strong, resourceful, creative person who knows how to use AI to solve real business and technology problems.



This is NOT an entry-level role, and we're NOT looking for someone whose only technical skill is prompting AI to generate code. A solid, hands-on technical background is essential. You should understand programming, Linux, servers, databases, APIs, networking fundamentals, troubleshooting, and how applications actually work.



You don't have to know every tool or language. You must be able to understand and verify AI-generated work, identify mistakes, investigate unfamiliar problems, make sensible technical decisions, and finish assignments.



The work is varied. One day you might build an application. The next you might troubleshoot a Linux server, plan a technical project, design a dashboard, connect APIs, automate a workflow, research a new product, or improve an existing business system.



You will work closely with our Founder and CEO. Over time, a successful candidate may grow into broader technical leadership. We are looking for a builder and problem solver first, not someone seeking an executive title immediately.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



AI, automation and general problem solving

- Use Codex, ChatGPT, and other approved AI tools productively and responsibly.

- Research, prototype, evaluate, and implement technical solutions.

- Create integrations, scripts, automations, and internal tools.

- Identify practical ways AI can improve development and operations.

- Check AI output for accuracy, security, reliability, and maintainability.



Software development

- Build and maintain custom web applications and business systems.

- Work with existing codebases as well as modern technologies.

- Develop APIs, database integrations, and web interfaces.

- Troubleshoot, test, document, and improve software.

- Use Git, Docker, and structured development workflows.



Systems administration and troubleshooting

- Assist with Linux server and hosting administration.

- Diagnose application, web server, network, database, and deployment issues.

- Help with updates, configurations, backups, monitoring, and reliability improvements.

- Collaborate with our existing systems administrator.

- Follow approved procedures for production and security-sensitive changes.



Design and user experience

- Create or improve website layouts, dashboards, forms, and application interfaces.

- Build responsive, usable interfaces and prototypes.

- Work with designers and WordPress developers when specialized help is needed.

- Use good visual judgment and AI-assisted creative tools appropriately.



Planning and delivery

- Turn business needs into implementation plans and manageable tasks.

- Research options, estimate effort, and identify dependencies and risks.

- Communicate progress and raise blockers early.

- Coordinate handoffs with developers, operations, and independent QA.

- Take assignments through testing, documentation, and completion.



REQUIRED

- Strong hands-on technical experience with software development and troubleshooting.

- Practical understanding of web applications, APIs, SQL databases, and server fundamentals.

- Linux and general system administration familiarity.

- Practical experience using AI tools for technical work, with the judgment to check their output.

- Ability to learn unfamiliar codebases and technologies.

- Strong independent problem solving, organization, and follow-through.

- Clear written English and some overlap with New York business hours.



USEFUL BUT NOT REQUIRED

- JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, PHP, Perl, or other languages.

- PostgreSQL/MySQL, Docker, Git, cloud hosting, and Linux administration.

- WordPress, n8n, CRM/helpdesk systems, and workflow automation.

- UI/UX tools such as Figma and graphic design experience.

- LLM APIs, AI agents, integrations, and technical project planning.



WHO WILL DO WELL HERE



You are curious, technically grounded, comfortable with variety, and willing to learn. You don't give up just because a problem is new. You ask good questions, use AI thoughtfully, explain your decisions, and finish what you start. You care about a tested, working result—not simply producing code or reports.



WORKING WITH US



This role begins with a paid part-time trial. Long-term hours and compensation will depend on results, business needs, and mutual fit. We work on New York time and require some schedule overlap, but can be flexible.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:

1. A short introduction describing your technical experience.

2. Two or three projects you personally contributed to, explaining your actual role.

3. Which AI tools you use and how you verify their output.

4. An example of a difficult technical problem you solved independently.

5. Your hands-on experience with Linux, systems administration, databases, and software development.

6. Your expected hourly rate, weekly availability, and New York time overlap.



Please don't send a generic AI-generated cover letter. We actively encourage using AI, but want to understand your own experience and judgment.



Shortlisted candidates may complete a paid assessment involving AI-assisted development, troubleshooting, planning, and communication.



If you enjoy solving practical problems, building useful technology, and using AI to accomplish more, we'd like to hear from you.





**IMPORTANT – APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS**



**PLEASE APPLY ONLY THROUGH THIS JOB POSTING.**



Do not contact me through personal social media, private messaging,
, or any other personal accounts.



**Anyone who attempts to bypass the application process by contacting me directly through personal channels will be automatically disqualified, and their application will not be reviewed.**



Please respect this requirement and follow the application instructions. Thank you.

title: Full-Time Customer Service Agent (E-commerce)
description:
Full-Time · Long-Term · Philippines (Remote)

Pay: $5.00–$7.00 USD/hour depending on experience Schedule: 40 hrs/week over 5 days, US Eastern Time — see "The honest version" below Type: Full-time, exclusive employment Start: Paid 2-week trial ? permanent



Before you apply



We're hiring one person for a role we want to be someone's home for years — not a gig, not a rotating bench of freelancers. That means a stable schedule, a fair rate paid on time, real benefits, and room to grow. In return, we're looking for someone who's genuinely happy doing this work well, day in and day out.



This post is longer and more detailed than most, on purpose. We'd rather tell you exactly what the job is — the good and the hard parts — so you can d
 honestly whether it fits your life. The best hires we've ever made are the ones who read all of this, recognized themselves in it, and thought "yes, that's me." If that's you, we'd love to hear from you.



The honest version of this job



The schedule is US Eastern hours, 5 days a week — roughly 9:00 PM – 6:00 AM Philippine time, with two days off. That's standard for most VA roles, so it may already be your normal. Some of your working days may fall on weekends; we'll agree your fixed days off together so you can plan your life around them.



It's the same work most days. Order status. Where's my package. Refund requests. Warranty claims. Someone who is angry about something that isn't your fault. The variety is in the people, not the tasks. If you need novelty to stay engaged, you'll be unhappy here.



You'll have a team around you. Two other support specialists work these same hours from the Philippines, and you'll report to our Customer Service Manager, who works alongside you on a similar schedule. You won't be isolated — you'll have people to ask, learn from, and lean on. We still need someone self-motivated: the best people here do careful, honest work because they take pride in it, not because someone is standing over them.



You will be measured. Response time, resolution rate, and customer satisfaction — reviewed with you weekly for the first month, then monthly. You'll always know where you stand. You will never be surprised by feedback.



What you'll actually do



- Answer customer emails, live chat, phone calls, and social media DMs/comments

- Look up and process orders in Shopify; track shipments; proactively update customers when something is late

- Issue refunds, handle returns and warranty claims, and de-escalate complaints

- Keep customer and order records accurate — including logging issues we should fix upstream

- Answer product questions and make simple recommendations

- Flag patterns: if five people ask the same question this week, we want to hear about it



What we need from you



- Based in the Philippines, working from a quiet space with fiber internet (25 Mbps+ real speed, not advertised speed)

- This is your only job. Not your main job — your only one. We pay a fair full-time rate, on time, and treat this as a real career, so that's a reasonable ask

- Hands-on Shopify admin experience. Not "familiar with." You should be able to find a partial refund option without a tutorial

- At least 1 year in e-commerce or BPO customer support, ideally for a US or Canadian brand

- Excellent written English — this is most of the job. Your writing should sound like a warm, competent human, not a template

- Comfortable on the phone with North American customers

- A backup plan for power and internet. A UPS or power bank plus a mobile data plan is the minimum — this is your responsibility to have in place

- Willing to provide two references we can actually call, including a direct supervisor

- When you apply, the first word of your email subject line must be BLUEBERRY.



What we offer

- $5–7 USD/hour depending on experience, paid every two weeks via Wise, on time, without exception

- Paid training during your first two weeks

- 13th month pay

- 5 days paid time off per year after your first year

- Reviewed for a raise at 6 months and annually after that — good work gets paid for, you won't have to ask

- A defined role with written processes, not a chaotic "wear all the hats" situation



How to apply

- Follow every instruction in this post — including the one that isn't in this section. We use this as our first filter, and most applications are eliminated here.



Send us:

1. Your resume and two references (name, role, company, and a working phone or WhatsApp number for each — we do call them).

2. A short written test. Below is a real customer message. Write the reply you'd send, in 150 words or less, plus two sentences on what you'd check in Shopify before sending it.



"This is the THIRD time I'm writing. I ordered on the 4th, tracking hasn't moved in 9 days, and nobody has answered me. I needed this for a gift that was LAST WEEKEND. I want a refund and I want to know why nobody bothered to respond. Honestly considering just doing a chargeback."



Write this yourself. We compare your writing to how you speak on video, and we can tell when they don't match. A real, human, slightly imperfect answer beats a polished AI one every time.



3. Your preferred working hours, in EST

4. Your expected hourly rate in USD.

5. A video (Loom or Google Drive, sharing enabled — test the link before you send it). Unedited, one take, 5 minutes or less. Applications without a video are not reviewed.



Video questions:

- Show us your workspace on camera right now. Run a live internet speed test on screen, and walk us through exactly what you do when the power goes out mid-shift.

- Tell us one thing about Shopify that most support agents get wrong. Be as specific and technical as you like.

- Describe a time you made a real mistake with a customer. What happened, what did it cost, and what did you change afterward? "I'm a perfectionist" answers get skipped.

- Of every job you've had, which one did you do your best work at — and what about it made that possible?

- What's the part of this job you think you'd struggle with most?



What happens next



1. We review applications and reply to everyone who followed the instructions

2. Short interview call

3. Reference calls

4. Paid 2-week trial at full rate, real work, real feedback

5. Permanent offer

description:
Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.

You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.

REQUIREMENTS

- Emotional intelligence

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE

title: Virtual Executive Assistant
description:
I'm the founder of a digital growth marketing company that helps mission-driven founders scale their businesses with more ease & less overwhelm - and I'm looking for a small team of highly-skilled Executive Assistants to help take over the marketing and management tasks that make a huge difference in the lives of the people that hire us.



I'm looking for a max of 5 amazing executive assistants available for part-time (potential for full time) with a salary starting at $500 USD per month and with long term success and robust training, moving up to $700 USD per month as an emerging leader in the company.



If you have the following skill sets, I encourage you to apply:



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:

- Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in Digital Marketing, Video Editing, Social Media Management, Content Creation, and Executive Assistant Work (Administrative Tasks, Calendar &
 Management, etc)

You’re trusted to manage marketing deliverables while providing high-level executive support, keeping priorities organized, systems moving, and leadership focused on growth instead of day-to-day execution. You've done it all from managing schedules to
 & calendar management. You have a meticulous eye for detail where Prioritization and Organization are your love language



-- 1+ years of experience in Sales Funnels and Shopify

You're a professional who is passionate about helping changemakers simplify their lives by setting up systems that will allow them to operate their businesses with more ease and less overwhelm. You have experience with sales funnel and CRM software



- 1+ years of experience advertising on platforms like Instagram,
, Tik Tok, within a Marketing team consisting of Paid Acquisition, Organic Marketing, Customer Retention, & Product Marketing

You're an emerging leader who has the potential to head a team in the future that will report directly to you. Having leadership experience is a MAJOR plus



- Creating SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures)

You’ll ensure each business function has detailed documentation for repeatable and scalable growth if it isn't already place. If you see gaps, you take the initiative to fill them and produce results without anyone knowing there was an issue (yea, all that and a bag of chips :-)



- Experience working at a digital/online product/platform: You’re familiar with online courses, digital products & platforms and popular tools in the business space ranging from landing page builders and
 service providers to CRMs, and course hosting platforms aren’t foreign to you (We teach tools like Shopify, Convertkit, Kajabi, Teachable, Learnworlds, Calendly, etc)



ABOUT YOU:

- “You down with SOP? Yeah you know me!”—You’re an advocate for SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) to make our systems repeatable & scalable.

- Your love language is processes & predictable, meteoric growth. We never question company progress towards the quarterly and yearly goals because you keep real-time metrics for all projects.

- You’re aware of new software and can look at current systems and identify how to automate tasks a company has been doing manually for months.

- You’re addicted to digital processes & automation in the world of social media because you love building connections in the digital space and you’ve seen how powerful it can be in business growth

- You’re driven by metrics & tracking. You know that you can’t improve something unless you measure it, so you develop ways to measure performance so your company is always predictably improving.

- Timeliness and deadlines are your jam. When we have a team call at 10:00am, you show up at 9:55am. When the deadline is Tuesday at 5:30pm, you have it done Monday.

- You overcommunicate clearly and confidently. If you agree/disagree with something, you communicate that without hesitation or overthinking. You’re no stranger to asking why we do things a certain way to ensure we’re intentional with our resources.

- You’re a leader and team player. Ego? What ego? If something needs to be done, you dive in to make sure all critical tasks are accounted and cared for.



If you’re nodding your head “Yes” to the above, proceed below to apply.



PERKS:

I'm committed to setting our staff up for success with access to trainings that will certify your skills in:

- Task & Calendar Management

- Launch/Sales Strategy Planning

- Sales Funnel Tech Setup (For E-Commerce or Service Based Businesses)

- Social Media Management

- Digital Media Marketing (Including
 and SMS Marketing)

- Lead Generation



After one week of training and assessment, you're officially certified under our internal training program, which means hitting the ground running with your new skills. Perks include:

- Part time work hours

- Work from anywhere in the world (as long as your internet signal is strong and computer is fast)

- Starting Salary at $400-$500 USD a month ($4800-$6000 USD annual)

- Internal certification program to enhance your professional skills in your career (I have helped clients amass at least $10M from the same digital growth marketing strategies I will require you to learn)



Interested? Please reply to this post with the secret keyword "APPLES" so I know you can pay attention to detail - from there, I'll let you know next steps if you qualify.

title: Remote Medical Billing & Patient Support Specialist
description:
Remote Medical Billing & Patient Support Specialist



All Kidz Urgent Care | Torrance, California, USA



Location: Remote – Philippines

Position: Full-Time | Monday–Friday

Working Hours: 2:00 AM to 10:00 AM in the Philippines  which is 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM in California (Pacific Daylight Time, UTC-7)

title: Founding Local SEO Strategist
description:
Most people who call themselves local SEOs have never gotten a suspended profile back. They've never pulled a fake review. They've never reported a spammer off the map pack. They optimize a profile when it's healthy and disappear the second Google punches it in the face.



I'm hiring for the opposite of that person.



I run these campaigns myself. I know exactly what "good" looks like at the platform level, so I'm going to be blunt about who I want. I want the operator who treats a suspension as a Tuesday, not a crisis. Who reads a nasty competitor review and immediately knows whether it's removable. Who has actually clawed a profile back to verified and can tell me how, without googling it while we talk.



If that's you, keep reading. If it's not, no hard feelings.



## Who we are



We're an established SEO agency helping local businesses rank at the top of Google. Mostly US home-service contractors (roofing, HVAC, cleaning, window cleaning), plus a handful of e-commerce brands. US-based, US clients. We already have the structure: documented SOPs, proven processes, and results that keep clients coming back. Google Business Profile is the center of gravity for almost everything we do, and it's where campaigns are won or lost.



## The role



This is our founding local SEO strategist seat. You own the Google Business Profile battlefield across our client base. Ranking profiles into the map pack, yes, but more importantly keeping them alive and clean when Google, competitors, and angry one-star reviewers come for them.



You're the first dedicated local hire stepping into a machine that already works, not a mess you have to clean up. The systems are built and they produce. Your job is to run them at a high level, own delivery, and make the systems themselves stronger, especially the reinstatement, review-defense, and spam-takedown playbooks that most agencies don't even have. This is a long-term seat. I want someone I can grow with for years.



## What you'll own



- **Suspension reinstatement.** When a profile gets suspended, you run the recovery. You know the difference between "suspended" and "not verified," you know to stack every piece of proof into the first appeal because you can't add more later, and you know the escalation ladder when the first appeal gets denied: second appeal, support forum with the ticket number and profile ID, live video verification call with a real Google rep. Getting a client back to live in days instead of the three weeks a generalist would burn is the whole job on a bad day.

- **Video verification and reverification.** You've passed it. You know what to do when the upload dies at 99 percent for the tenth time, and you know the documentation angle (state registration, DBA, business license matching the address, Secretary of State lookup) that gets a human reviewer to approve.

- **Review defense and removal.** You know Google's review content policy cold, so you can look at a review and call whether it's removable before you waste a flag on it. You report policy-violating and competitor reviews through the right channel, you coordinate the team to submit reports from multiple accounts when a review genuinely violates policy, and you appeal legitimate reviews that got wrongly filtered or removed back onto the profile instead of shrugging and chasing new ones.

- **Competitor spam takedowns.** Keyword-stuffed business names, fake addresses, lead-gen listings with no real location. You spot them and you report them through the Business Redressal Complaint Form. This is a sanctioned tactic, not black hat, and used well it clears the map pack of the exact fakes that are outranking our clients.

- **Duplicate listing cleanup.** Finding, merging, and recovering reviews off duplicate and lost listings without nuking the review count on the surviving profile.

- **Ranking the map pack.** Primary category strategy (the single biggest lever, and you know it), proximity and service-area logic, review velocity systems that build without tripping the filter, and the engagement signals that actually hold a position once you've won it.

- **Review generation systems** that run themselves: QR at the truck and the job-completion email, service-plus-location seeding in the ask, response cadence inside 12 to 24 hours, warmed-up sending so you don't torch deliverability on day one.

- **Citations and NAP hygiene** as a floor, not a monthly deliverable we pretend is moving the needle. You know the consistency threshold that matters and you know when to stop.

- **On-page and technical support** for the money pages the profile feeds: local landing pages, schema, internal linking, indexing new pages with a real indexer instead of praying to GSC.

- **Documentation.** Every play you run, you turn into an SOP the next hire can follow.



## Who you are



- **Native-level English.** You'll talk to me constantly and sometimes to clients. Non-negotiable.

- **An over-communicator.** This is the one I care about most. I want too many updates, not too few. When a profile goes down I want to hear it from you before I notice it myself.

- **Calm when Google isn't.** A suspension is a puzzle, not a panic. You work the process, you document what worked, you tell me what you learned.

- **Fluent across the whole spectrum.** White hat, grey hat, and enough understanding of black hat to know exactly where the line is and why we don't drag client assets across it. You know the shortcuts other people use to fake addresses, spoof verifications, and buy reviews, and you know precisely why we don't do those on a client's real business. Knowing the dark playbook is how you recognize it in a competitor and how you defend against it. Running it on a client's profile is how you get them wiped.

- **Always sharpening.** Google changes the reinstatement flow, the review policy, and the verification process constantly. The day you stop keeping up is the day you stop being useful here.



## What you've actually done



- **Reinstated a real suspended profile.** Not read about it. Done it. You can walk me through an actual recovery: what got it suspended, what you submitted, how long it took, and what you'd do differently. This is the single biggest thing I'm screening for.

- **Removed a review that violated policy**, and recovered a legitimate review that got wrongly filtered. You know both directions of the review fight.

- **Reported a spam listing off the map pack** using the redressal form and watched a fake competitor drop.

- **Passed video verification** and handled the ugly edge cases (upload failures, reverification, home-address service-area profiles).

- **Ranked multiple local businesses** into the map pack and held them there. You knew the lever, you pulled it, the position moved.

- **Comfortable with AI and automation.** You automate the boring parts (review sequences, reporting, monitoring) instead of grinding them by hand. Comfortable with Claude, wiring up simple APIs, and spinning up local landing pages fast.

- **Expert in the core tools:** Semrush or Ahrefs, GSC, GA4, GBP itself, and bonus points for BrightLocal and an indexer.

- **Worked on a team before.** You know how to hand off, document, and collaborate.



## What I offer



- **Growth that's real.** As we add clients, the role grows and your pay grows with it. $2,000/mo to start, scaling toward $3,000+ as you take on more ownership, and higher over time as we grow together.

- **A real path to managing.** You're the founding local hire. As the team grows, the right person becomes the one who runs it.

- **Real ownership.** No bureaucracy, no ten layers of approval. You own local here and you'll feel it.



## Logistics



- **Full-time, remote.**

- **Overlap with US business hours.** I need at least 4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern Time so we can collaborate in real time. Tell me your timezone and normal working hours.

- Start date: as soon as we find the right person.



## How to apply



Send me the following, and yes, I read every single one:



1. Your favorite vegetable and why. Put this at the very top of your application so I know you read the whole post. No vegetable, no reply.

2. Your name and age

3. What motivates you, be brutally honest. "Money" is a fine answer if it's the true one. I trust honest people more than polished ones.

4. Your local SEO experience, with a focus on GBP

5. The gnarliest GBP problem you've ever solved, and how you solved it

6. One technical answer: a client's Google Business Profile just got suspended right after you updated their business name. Walk me through your reinstatement play, step by step, in the order you'd actually do it.



Apply here:

description:
About the Role



We are looking for an experienced Credit & Funding Specialist who understands credit reporting, the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), credit bureau disputes, litigation support, and funding processes.



This is not a basic administrative VA position. We need a knowledgeable, proactive, detail-oriented professional who can become our go-to person for credit-related matters, FCRA compliance workflows, credit bureau dispute cases, and funding opportunities.



The ideal candidate has hands-on experience, understands how to organize and manage complex credit cases, and can work independently while keeping operations organized and compliant.



 Key Responsibilities



**1. Credit Analysis & Disputes**

- Review credit reports from Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion.

- Identify inaccurate, incomplete, inconsistent, or potentially unverifiable credit reporting for further review.

- Prepare and manage credit bureau dispute workflows, correspondence, supporting documentation, and follow-ups.

- Track dispute timelines, bureau responses, client progress, and case documentation.

- Research applicable FCRA requirements and maintain organized records of relevant findings.



**2. FCRA & Litigation Support**

- Understand FCRA-related consumer rights and common credit reporting compliance issues.

- Assist with identifying and documenting potential FCRA violations.

- Organize evidence, credit reports, dispute histories, bureau responses, timelines, and other supporting records.

- Prepare case files and documentation for review by qualified legal counsel.

- Support litigation-related workflows involving credit bureaus, including coordinating documentation and tracking case progress.

- Help maintain accurate records of complaints, correspondence, and escalations.



*Important: This role involves research, documentation, and litigation support. Legal advice, legal representation, and legal filings must be handled by appropriately qualified or authorized individuals.*



**3. Credit & Funding**

- Assist with credit-based funding and personal or business funding processes.

- Evaluate credit profiles and funding readiness against applicable requirements.

- Research legitimate funding opportunities, lenders, eligibility requirements, and underwriting criteria.

- Help organize funding applications, required documents, submissions, and follow-ups.

- Track application progress, decisions, and next steps.

- Identify opportunities to improve funding readiness based on documented requirements.



**4. Client & Operational Management**

- Maintain accurate client records and case notes.

- Use CRMs, spreadsheets, and other online tools to track cases and funding applications.

- Create repeatable workflows and standard operating procedures.

- Communicate clearly, protect confidential information, and meet deadlines.

- Take ownership of assigned cases and proactively identify problems.



## Required Qualifications



- Proven experience in credit repair, credit reporting, credit disputes, or credit consulting.

- Strong working knowledge of the FCRA and credit bureau dispute processes.

- Practical experience documenting potential credit reporting violations or supporting FCRA-related cases.

- Experience organizing case documentation for attorney review is highly preferred.

- Hands-on experience with personal credit funding, business funding, or lender application processes.

- Strong written English and excellent attention to detail.

- Ability to work independently, research problems, and manage multiple cases.

- Comfortable using CRMs, spreadsheets, and online business tools.

- High level of integrity, confidentiality, and professionalism.



Preferred Qualifications



- Experience working with consumer rights attorneys or legal professionals on credit reporting matters.

- Experience preparing organized case files involving Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion.

- Experience with business credit, personal funding, or funding readiness assessments.

- Ability to build efficient workflows and improve existing processes.



How to Apply
