title: Strategic Finance & Operations Manager
description:
About Lula



Lula Commerce is a fast-growing SaaS and marketplace platform for the convenience retail industry. We work with some of the largest convenience chains in the country, along with thousands of independent operators, to run their digital ordering, delivery, and retail data infrastructure.



We run several revenue models at the same time — subscriptions, revenue-share partnerships, GMV-based programs, and project work — and roughly 7,200 billing, payout, and collections items move through the business every month.



Almost all of that is manual today. That is the problem you are here to solve.







The Role



This role has two halves, and we want to be direct about both.



The first half is operational and hands-on. You will run billing, collections, and partner payouts. You will reconcile numbers across Stripe, ACH, Bill.com, partner reports, and our own product data. You will chase overdue accounts and untangle the payout disputes that come with a business this size. For the first stretch, this work will be real, repetitive, and high-volume.



The second half is why we think the right person will want this job. You are expected to systematically eliminate that first half. We want someone who reaches for SQL, Python, Claude Code, and automation tooling by instinct — who looks at a manual reconciliation process and thinks in terms of the script that should be doing it. The measure of success here is how much of your own workload you have automated away, and what you were able to take on with the time you got back.



Underneath both halves is a third expectation: you become the person we come to when a question needs a real answer. Before a partner negotiation, a pricing decision, or a board meeting, we should be able to hand you a messy problem and get back a clear one — here is the data, here is what it says, here is what it means for the business, here is what I would do.



You will report directly to the CEO and work closely with the CPO, our outsourced accounting team, Sales, and Account Management.



This is a customer-facing role.



We want to be explicit about this, because it is a real part of the job and not an occasional exception.



You will speak with customers and partners directly, and you will represent Finance in those conversations without a founder on the call. In practice, that means handling situations like a multi-store operator telling you their payout is wrong, or that a payment never arrived. You will need to be able to go into the underlying transaction data, figure out what actually happened, and explain it clearly and confidently to someone who is frustrated and whose money is involved.



You will also lead conversations about billing disputes, contract and revenue-share interpretation, overdue balances, and account suspension. Some of these are difficult conversations. We need someone who can hold them calmly, with the numbers in hand.



What you'll own



Billing, collections, and partner payouts - Own invoicing, collections, dunning, failed payments, and account suspension across subscriptions, revenue-share agreements, and project billing. - Own recurring revenue-share and partner payout processing, and resolve discrepancies end to end with customers, partners, and vendors. - Reconcile revenue and payouts across Stripe, ACH, Bill.com, partner reports, and internal systems. - Improve cash collection and give leadership a dependable view of AR.



Automation and systems building - Replace manual, error-prone finance workflows with systems you design and build — using SQL, Python, APIs, AI-enabled tooling, and automation platforms. - Build the exception logic that matters: workflows that flag overdue accounts, catch discrepancies early, and surface only what genuinely needs human judgment. - Create the documentation, controls, and data-quality standards that make complex pricing and partner arrangements repeatable rather than tribal knowledge.



Analysis and decision support - Pull data from multiple systems, clean it, and answer open-ended business questions with it. -Prepare the analysis behind partner negotiations, pricing and packaging decisions, and customer economics — bottom line first, methodology available. - Build and maintain dashboards for ARR, ARPU, ARPS, gross margin, collections, cash, burn, and runway.



Forecasting and reporting - Build and maintain forecasts across subscription, revenue-share, GMV-based, and project revenue, and model customer growth, launch timing, retention, ARPU, gross margin, cash, and runway. - Translate pipeline, contracted stores, live stores, and customer activity into revenue forecasts you can defend. - Compare forecast to actuals, investigate variances, and update assumptions as the business changes. - Prepare monthly leadership and board reporting materials, and support the outsourced accounting team through a timely monthly close



What we're looking for



Roughly 3–6 years across strategic finance, FP&A, finance operations, revenue operations, business operations, or a closely related field.



Working SQL. You can get to data yourself across multiple systems without waiting on anyone.



Real automation experience. Some Python, comfort with APIs, and proficiency with Claude Code or similar AI development tooling. You have built things that removed work permanently, and you can point to them.



Strong financial modeling in Excel or Google Sheets, including building models from scratch.



Genuine comfort with messy source data — the ability to investigate inconsistencies and reach a well-supported answer rather than an approximate one.



Startup experience, ideally Seed through Series B, in SaaS, marketplace, ecommerce, delivery, restaurant tech, logistics, or fintech.



Strong ownership and urgency. You communicate early, meet commitments, and keep work moving without repeated follow-up.



The ability to explain financial information clearly to people who don't work in finance — including customers.



Helpful, not required: revenue-share, GMV, or multi-sided marketplace models; Stripe, Bill.com, QuickBooks, or NetSuite; BI tooling; US GAAP and SaaS revenue recognition



What success looks like



In your first few months, billing, collections, and partner payouts are accurate and consistent, and leadership has a reliable view of revenue, cash, runway, and unit economics.



By six months, a meaningful share of the manual work you inherited is running on systems you built, and discrepancies surface before anyone outside the company notices them.



Most importantly, you become the person who can take an ambiguous financial or operational question, find the right data, determine the answer, and build a repeatable process around it.



Why Lula



You will work directly with company leadership, with unusual visibility into how a multi-revenue-model business actually works, and with the freedom to rebuild how Finance and Business Operations function as we scale. If you like bringing order to complexity and building systems that make yesterday's problems disappear, we would like to hear from you.



We are remote-first. You will be asked to come to our Cherry Hill, NJ office occasionally — roughly once every few months.



If interested, please send your resume to

title: Bilingual Cold Caller / Appointment Setter (English–Spanish) — Paid Per Result — Miami Web Services Company
description:
A family-run Miami web services company is looking for an experienced bilingual cold caller. We build websites and customer systems for local businesses, and we need a caller to work from our own screened list of local businesses and book short introductory calls for our team. The company's name is shared when you contact us.



This is a results-only position — there is no hourly wage and no retainer. You earn three ways:

• You get paid for appointments — for every qualified appointment that actually takes place (the business owner or decision-maker attends the scheduled call).

• You get paid for closing the deal — when a client signs with us from one of your appointments, you earn a closing bonus on top of the appointment pay — and again for any other recurring service that client takes with us (care plans, managed IT, or any other monthly service they add). Our websites range from $3,000 (basic site) to $15,000 (full system), so every signed client is real money in your pocket — the better your appointments, the more you earn.

• You get paid a monthly percentage for recurring services — website care plans and managed IT services are billed monthly, and you receive a percentage of those monthly plans for as long as your clients keep them. That is recurring income that pays you every month, on top of the appointment pay and the closing bonus.



Work at your own pace: there is no fixed schedule and nobody watching the clock. You choose your own hours and your own rhythm — the only limit is the legal calling window (daytime to early evening, Eastern time), and you work whenever inside it suits you.



The job: call local Miami-area businesses (owners of plumbing, electrical, cleaning, moving, and similar service companies) during business hours, introduce our company in a short, honest pitch, and book a free short website review call. You never quote prices and never close — our team runs the meeting and the sale. Scripts and the call list are provided; every call is logged, and calls may be recorded for quality (you will announce this on each call).



You are: fluent in English and Spanish · equipped with your own phone/computer and a quiet place to call · comfortable being paid purely on results — and you fit one of these two profiles:

• Experienced: you have cold-called U.S. businesses before and you have the results to prove it — or

• Highly motivated: you may not have a long résumé, but you are hungry to work, eager to learn, and serious about earning extra cash. If you bring the drive, we train you on our structure — scripts, call list, and system are all provided — your motivation does the rest.



The person who does well here is a closer at heart: hungry — you treat every dial like money sitting on the table, and you go get it · driven — you want more than a paycheck; you are building real extra income and you act like it · competitive — a "no" doesn't slow you down, it aims you at the next call · resilient — rejection rolls off you and the next dial is a new chance · persistent but respectful — you follow up, and you stop cleanly at a clear no · honest to the core — you log real outcomes, never fake bookings (pay is per result, and every result is verified) · self-disciplined — remote work, nobody watching, you keep your own pace · organized — clean call logs, nothing falls through · warm and professional on the phone — owners trust you in the first seconds · a good listener — you hear the objection behind the objection · coachable — you take feedback from call recordings and get better every week · money-motivated — the per-result pay excites you more than a fixed wage would.



This is an independent contractor position, remote, you set your own schedule. To apply: contact us by WhatsApp message only — please do not call. Send your resume or a written summary of your work experience (cold-calling and appointment-setting work especially) and a short voice recording, about a minute long, introducing yourself in English and Spanish and describing your experience and results.

title: Full-Time Customer Service Agent (Shopify E-commerce)
description:
Pay: $5–7 USD/hour, depending on experience

Schedule: 40 hrs/week, 5 days, US Eastern Time

Type: Full-time, exclusive

Start: Paid 2-week trial → permanent role



About this role



We're hiring one person we hope will stay for years. We offer a steady schedule, fair pay on time, real benefits, and room to grow. In return, we want someone who enjoys doing this work well, every day.

This post is detailed so you can d
 honestly if the job fits your life.



The honest version



- Hours: About 9:00 PM – 6:00 AM Philippine time, 5 days a week. Some workdays may be weekends, but your two days off are fixed and agreed together.

- The work is repetitive: Order status, tracking, refunds, warranty claims, and upset customers. If you need variety, this isn't the job for you.

- You'll have a team: Two other support specialists work the same hours, and you'll report to our Customer Service Manager on a similar schedule. We still need someone who works carefully without being watched.

- You'll be measured: Response time, resolution rate, and customer satisfaction, reviewed weekly for your first month, then monthly. No surprises.



What you'll do



- Answer customers by
, chat, phone, and social media

- Process orders in Shopify, track shipments, and update customers when orders are late

- Handle refunds, returns, warranty claims, and complaints

- Keep records accurate and log recurring problems

- Answer product questions

- Tell us when you notice patterns in what customers ask



What we need



- Based in the Philippines, with a quiet workspace and fiber internet (25 Mbps+ real speed)

- This must be your only job. We pay a fair full-time rate and treat this as a real career.

- Hands-on Shopify admin experience (not just "familiar with")

- 1+ year in e-commerce or BPO customer support, ideally for a US or Canadian brand

- Excellent written English that sounds warm and human

- Comfortable on the phone with North American customers

- Backup power and internet (at minimum, a UPS or power bank plus mobile data)

- Two references we can call, including a direct supervisor

- When you apply, the first word of your
 subject line must be BLUEBERRY.



What we offer

- $5–7 USD/hour, paid every two weeks via Wise, always on time

- Paid training for your first two weeks

- 13th month pay

- 5 days paid time off per year after your first year

- Raise reviews at 6 months, then yearly

- A clear role with written processes



How to apply

Follow every instruction in this post, including the one that isn't in this section. Most applications are eliminated here.

Send us:

1. Your resume and two references (name, role, company, and phone or WhatsApp number for each)

2. A written test. Reply to this customer message in 150 words or less, then write two sentences on what you'd check in Shopify first:



"This is the THIRD time I'm writing. I ordered on the 4th, tracking hasn't moved in 9 days, and nobody has answered me. I needed this for a gift that was LAST WEEKEND. I want a refund and I want to know why nobody bothered to respond. Honestly considering just doing a chargeback."



Write this yourself. We compare it to how you speak on video. A real, slightly imperfect answer beats a polished AI one.

3. Your preferred working hours (EST)

4. Your expected hourly rate (USD)

5. A video (Loom or Google Drive, sharing on, link tested). One take, unedited, 5 minutes max. No video, no review.



In your video:

- Show your workspace, run a live internet speed test on screen, and explain what you do if the power goes out mid-shift.

- Tell us one thing about Shopify most support agents get wrong.

- Describe a real mistake you made with a customer, what it cost, and what you changed afterward.

- Tell us which job you did your best work at, and why.

- Tell us which part of this job you'd struggle with most.



What happens next



1. We reply to everyone who followed the instructions

2. Short interview call

3. Reference calls

4. Paid 2-week trial at full rate

5. Permanent offer

title: Senior Creative Strategist to Build and Lead Our Ad Department (Home & Lighting E-commerce Brand, UK + Germany)
description:
Senior Creative Strategist for a Home & Lighting E-commerce Brand



We are a growing home and decor e-commerce brand with lighting and lamps as our core products, currently selling in the UK and Germany. The brand is already performing well. Now we want to raise our creative output and scale toward 7 figures with a deep, high-performing content library.



To get there, we are looking for an experienced Senior Creative Strategist who will build our ad department from the ground up. You will lead a team of video editors and static designers and report directly to our CEO.



This is not a junior role. We are looking for someone who has done this before, ideally in the home and decor, interior, lighting or lifestyle niche.



ABOUT THE ROLE



This is a fully remote lead role. You will own the creative strategy for all of our paid social advertising and act as the creative lead of our content team. You are a strategist who is also hands-on: you write scripts, shape static ad concepts, and jump into editing or design yourself when it helps. Your focus is making sure every piece of content fits one clear, logical funnel, from the first hook to the sale.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Build and run the creative strategy and content roadmap for all paid social ads (Meta first), across video and static.



Audit our Meta Ads Manager account on a regular basis and translate the data into clear creative direction: which hooks, angles, formats and concepts are working, which are not, and why. You know when a winner needs iterations and when it is time to develop something completely new.



Do in-depth market and competitor research in our current markets (UK and Germany): competitor ads, ad libraries, Amazon and marketplace reviews, customer language, trends and buying motivations.



Turn your research, the ad data and the CEO's own ideas into new, concrete ad concepts, with video scripts, static ad direction, briefs and shot lists.



Make full use of our production resources: the CEO's own film studio for custom content, and our AI content capabilities. You write the concepts, scripts and shot lists that get filmed and produced.



Lead, brief and review the work of our video editors and static designers. You know exactly what each of them needs to deliver strong ads, and you make sure every creative is on brief, on brand and consistent in messaging, angles and funnel logic.



Set up and manage a structured testing system: a clear testing roadmap, naming conventions, and tracking of every test, so results are measurable and we never have to guess what works and what does not.



Build and organize a structured content database, so we can produce at volume without losing quality.



Report back to the CEO on a weekly basis: what worked, what did not, what we learned, and what we are testing next.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



At least 3 years of experience as a Creative Strategist for e-commerce or DTC brands.



A proven track record with performance-driven video and static ads on Meta 
 and Instagram). You can show results.



Experience in the home and decor, interior, lighting or lifestyle niche is a big plus.



Experience building and leading a creative team of editors and designers. This is essential.



Hands-on skills: you are comfortable editing video and designing static ads yourself when needed.



Comfortable working inside Meta Ads Manager and reading the data yourself (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA, ROAS and so on).



Sharp on funnel logic, hooks, angles and message-to-market fit.



Very structured and organized. You think in systems, processes and databases, not just ideas.



Strong English, written and spoken. Understanding of the UK and German markets is a plus.



Able to give and receive direct feedback, and to communicate clearly with the CEO.



HOW WE WORK: PAID ONE-WEEK TRIAL



We start with a paid one-week trial. During this week you will:



1. Do a first audit of our Meta Ads Manager account and share your main findings.

2. Do quick market and competitor research for the UK and Germany.

3. Deliver 3 new ad concepts based on your findings, including at least one concept that uses the CEO's film studio.

4. Propose a simple testing plan and structure for how you would organize our creative testing and content database.



WHAT WE OFFER



A fixed monthly salary, plus a performance bonus based on ad spend per concept. We will discuss the exact structure with the right candidate.



A long-term, full-time role. We want someone who grows with the brand as we scale.



The chance to build an ad department from scratch, with real ownership and direct access to the CEO.



Production resources most strategists do not have: a dedicated film studio and AI content capabilities.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include the following in your application:



1. Relevant creative work for e-commerce brands, ideally in home, lighting or lifestyle (ad examples, portfolio, case studies or a content library you built).

2. A short description of a brand account you led creatively: what you changed and what the result was.

3. Your experience leading editors and designers.

4. How you would structure creative testing so that every result is measurable.



Start your application with the words "HOME DECOR STRATEGIST" so we know you have read the full post.



We review every serious application. Generic applications without examples will not be considered.

title: Australian Insurance Claims Support Officer
description:
Claims Support Officer



Remote | Philippines-Based | AEST Hour

 

**To Apply** 

 

The Claims Support Officer will provide administrative support to the Claims Consultant and help progress insurance claims accurately and promptly. Working under the Claims Consultant’s direction, the role will assist with claims lodgements, insurer follow-ups, documentation requests, record maintenance, and general claims administration for an Australian insurance broking firm.





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 



Claims Lodgements 

- Assist the Claims Consultant with lodging new insurance claims 

- Gather and collate the required information, then lodge claims accurately and promptly in accordance with the Claims Consultant’s instructions 

- Record claim details and relevant updates in the appropriate systems and CRM 



 Insurer and Claims Follow-Up 

- Contact insurers, claims teams, and assessors to obtain updates on outstanding claims 

- Make follow-up calls and remain on hold as required to confirm claim status, outstanding requirements, and next steps 

- Follow up when responses, reports, assessments, or decisions are overdue 

- Monitor insurer commitments and follow up agreed actions within the required timeframes 

- Escalate delays, issues, or concerns promptly to the Claims Consultant 



 Documentation and Information Requests 

- Send follow-up correspondence to clients or relevant parties only as instructed by the Claims Consultant 

- Request required claim documentation, including causation reports, damage photos, dates of loss or event, quotes, scopes of work, invoices, receipts, proof of ownership, and repair or replacement information 

- Follow up outstanding documentation and report progress to the Claims Consultant 

- File and record all information received accurately in the appropriate claim file and system 



 Claims Administration 

- Monitor open claims and maintain accurate, current claim records 

- Diary and action follow-ups to help keep claims progressing 

- Review insurer correspondence, identify outstanding actions, and prepare relevant information for the Claims Consultantz

- Maintain organised claim files and save all correspondence and supporting documentation correctly 

- Complete general claims administration and other tasks as directed by the Claims Consultant 





REPORTING STRUCTURE AND ROLE BOUNDARIES 



The Claims Support Officer reports directly to the Claims Consultant and performs all duties under their direction. This is primarily an administrative and support-based role. 



- The role does not independently manage client relationships, provide claims advice, or make decisions on behalf of the broker or Claims Consultant 

- All client-facing matters and substantive claims discussions remain the responsibility of the Claims Consultant 

- Client or third-party follow-ups must be limited to the specific tasks and instructions provided by the Claims Consultant 



 

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE 



You Must Have 

- Previous experience in administration, claims support, insurance support, or a similarly process-driven role 

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy when handling claim information and documentation 

- Excellent organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to monitor multiple follow-ups and deadlines 

- Clear and professional communication skills, including confidence contacting insurers and other parties for factual updates and outstanding information 

- Ability to follow detailed instructions, work within defined authority, and escalate issues appropriately 

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and confidence learning CRM and claims-management systems

- Ability to handle confidential information responsibly and work full-time during Australian business hours, Monday to Friday 



Nice to Have 

- Experience working for an insurance brokerage or general insurer 

- Previous exposure to insurance claims lodgement and claims administration 

- Experience communicating with insurers, claims teams, loss assessors, or repairers and using insurance, claims, or CRM systems 

- Basic understanding of the general insurance claims lifecycle and its common documentation





**To Apply**

Who We're Looking For

We're building a dedicated team of asset finance support professionals to work directly with Australian asset finance brokers. Post-settlement tasks — invoice reconciliation, asset registration follow-up, client retention



You Must Have

2–3 years of experience in Australian asset finance — broker-side, not lender operations

Asset finance product knowledge — equipment finance, chattel mortgage, novated lease, hire purchase, commercial hire purchase, finance lease, operating lease

Lender portal experience — submitting and tracking applications with major AU asset finance lenders (e.g. Westpac, NAB, ANZ, Macquarie, Pepper Money, Angle Finance, Grow Finance, Shift, ScotPac, Liberty, Fifo Capital)

Income assessment — PAYG, self-employed, company, and trust financials for asset finance purposes

CRM proficiency — Mercury, Salesforce, or comparable broker CRM

Understanding of GST, ABN, and tax implications relevant to asset finance structures

AEST business hours — full-time, Monday to Friday

Excellent written and spoken English — direct communication with brokers, clients, and lenders



Minimum Requirements

Strong understanding of chattel mortgage and finance lease structures

Comfortable handling multiple files simultaneously with strict attention to detail and deadlines

Familiar with PPSR (Personal Property Securities Register) searches and registrations

Understanding of responsible lending obligations and privacy requirements under Australian law

Proficient in Microsoft Office — Word, Excel, Outlook

Fast internet connection and professional home office setup





Nice to Have

Experience with novated leasing or fleet finance

Exposure to construction equipment, yellow goods, or specialised asset classes

Familiarity with commercial property-backed asset finance

Experience using ApplyOnline, Loanapp, or Simpology for commercial submissions

Cert IV in Finance & Mortgage Broking or equivalent





Education

A bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field is preferred but not required. We value hands-on Australian asset finance experience above qualifications. Candidates without a degree but with 2+ years of direct broker support experience are strongly encouraged to apply.



What We Offer

Competitive base salary based on experience

HMO coverage

Leave credits

13th Month Pay

Career growth — we're building a 50+ person capability centre within 12 months





About the Role

This is a direct broker support role — you work for the broker, not a lender or bank. You are the engine behind the broker's business, managing their asset finance pipeline, keeping deals moving, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks between application and settlement.

You'll be part of Pierian Australia's dedicated back-office capability centre, supporting Australian asset finance brokers across commercial equipment, vehicles, technology, and other asset classes.

title: Video Editor for Music Brand – YouTube Long-Form + Reels / TikTok / Shorts
description:
Hi, I'm Oliver – a German house music producer and DJ (Oliver River) and the founder of Living Electronics, a brand for sample packs, Serum presets and music production tutorials.



I'm looking for a long-term video editor for two things: YouTube tutorials for Living Electronics and short-form videos for both brands.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

1. YouTube long-form (Living Electronics)

- Music production tutorials and breakdowns, 10–25 minutes, from screen recordings (Ableton, Serum) plus facecam

- Turn long raw recordings into a tight video: cut mistakes and dead air, zoom into the part of the screen I'm talking about, add labels and graphics, add chapters

- Clean up my voice (levels, noise) while keeping every music example untouched

- About 2 videos per month to start, more later



2. Short-form (both brands)

- Around 6–10 short videos per week (13–45 seconds, 9:16) for Instagram, TikTok and YouTube Shorts

- Oliver River: studio moments, new songs, track flips, DJ clips. Music first, warm and filmic look.

- Living Electronics: quick production tips – partly cut from the long-form videos

- Cut on the beat, add on-screen text hooks (I give you the text) and captions where needed



Turnaround: 48 hours for a batch of shorts, 4–5 days for a long-form video.



WHAT I NEED FROM YOU

- 2+ years of editing, including YouTube long-form (tutorials, educational or talking-head) and short-form

- Pacing: long videos that keep people watching without feeling rushed, short videos cut to the rhythm

- A good ear: the music is the product. No clipped audio, no cut-off endings, no random sound effects over my tracks

- CapCut, DaVinci Resolve or Premiere Pro

- A computer that handles 4K footage and a stable internet connection

- Good written English and reliable communication – tell me early if something is unclear or running late



BONUS

- You know Ableton or Serum, or at least electronic music production – it helps to understand what's on screen

- You listen to house, UK garage or other electronic music

- YouTube thumbnails, motion graphics, color grading (warm, analog film looks)



HOW WE WORK

- Footage and finished videos via Dropbox

- Mostly async – a short overlap with my morning (9–11 AM CET = 4–6 PM PH time) is enough

- At the start I give written feedback on every video; that gets less as you learn my style

- Long-term: if it works, more hours and a raise after 3 months



HOW TO APPLY

Please use the subject line "On the beat – [your name]" so I know you read the whole post, and send me:

1. At least 1 link to a YouTube video (8+ minutes) you edited

2. 3 links to short-form edits you made that use music

   (for every link: tell me what you did on it)

3. The editing tools you use

4. How many hours per week you're available and your monthly rate

5. One song you've had on repeat lately



Shortlisted applicants get a paid test task ($40).



Thanks – looking forward to your edits!

Oliver

title: Short Form Video Editor
description:
(Read entire application before applying, there is information in here that will make or break your application)



Remote | Full-Time | Long-Term Position

Salary: $1,000–$2,000 CAD/month



Content Crew is looking for talented Video Editors to join our remote creative team.



We work with entrepreneurs, business owners, coaches, and personal brands to turn raw footage into engaging content for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube,
, and LinkedIn.



We're looking for editors who understand that great editing isn't about adding as many effects as possible.



It's about holding attention, telling a story, and making content people actually want to watch.



Compensation & Growth



Starting salary is $1,000 CAD/month, with opportunities to increase your compensation as you grow with the team.



Our Senior Editors currently earn up to $2,000 CAD/month.



We're looking for people who want to stay with Content Crew long-term, continuously improve their skills, take on more responsibility, and grow their compensation along the way.



If you're a great editor, reliable, and consistently produce high-quality work, there is a clear opportunity to progress within our team.



What You'll Be Editing



You'll work on content including:



* Short-form Reels, TikToks, and YouTube Shorts

* Talking-head educational content

* Podcasts and long-form YouTube videos

* Meta/Facebook ads

* Client testimonials and case studies

* Promotional videos

* Personal brand content



What We're Looking For



We're looking for editors with a strong creative eye who understand modern social media content.



You should understand:



* Strong hooks and attention-grabbing openings

* Fast, intentional pacing

* Cutting unnecessary pauses and filler

* B-roll selection and placement

* Music and sound design

* Captions and text animation

* Zooms, punch-ins, and pattern interrupts

* Basic colour correction and audio cleanup

* Editing for viewer retention

* How editing styles should change between organic content, ads, podcasts, and YouTube



CapCut is our preferred editing software, but we're open to editors using other programs if you can produce great work.



We're much more interested in the quality of your edits than what software you use.



You'll Be a Great Fit If You...



* Have a strong sense of pacing and storytelling

* Understand current social media editing styles

* Can take raw footage and make creative decisions independently

* Pay attention to small details

* Communicate well

* Hit deadlines consistently

* Take feedback well

* Can turn around edits quickly

* Want a long-term position with a growing creative team



How Our Hiring Process Works



We want to keep our hiring process simple and fast.



Step 1 — Portfolio + Loom Introduction



To apply, send us your portfolio AND a short Loom video introducing yourself.



We're not looking for a polished or scripted introduction. We just want to get to know the person behind the portfolio.



In your Loom, please answer these four questions:



1. What's your name, age, and location?



2. Tell us a little about yourself.

What do you like doing outside of work? Hobbies, interests, sports, games, travel — whatever you're into.



3. How did you get into video editing?



4. What do you like AND dislike about video editing?



Keep it casual. Just be yourself.



Alongside your Loom, send us a link to your portfolio with examples of your best editing work, especially short-form and social media content.



Step 2 — 24-Hour Editing Test



If we love your portfolio and think you could be a great fit for Content Crew, we'll reach out to arrange a test edit.



We'll send you raw footage and assets, and you'll have 24 hours to turn them into a finished video.



We will only ask you to complete a test edit if we are seriously considering hiring you.



We don't want to waste your time.



If you're receiving a test from us, it means we liked your work, we liked your application, and we believe there's a real possibility of you joining our team.



The test is simply our opportunity to see how you approach our footage, how you make creative decisions, and whether your editing style fits our clients.



Step 3 — Hiring Decision



We move fast.



If we love your test video and think you're a good fit, we'll make our hiring decision the following day.



No weeks of interviews.



No five-round hiring process.



Portfolio + Loom → 24-Hour Test → Hiring Decision



How to Apply



Please send us:



1. Your portfolio

Include your strongest examples of short-form and social media editing.



2. Your Loom introduction

Answer the four questions listed above.



3. Your availability

Let us know whether you're available full-time and when you could start.



4. Your primary editing software

CapCut is preferred, but not required.



Applications without both a portfolio and Loom introduction will not be considered.



We're looking for editors who want to become **long-term members of Content Crew, improve their skills, work on great content, and grow with our team.



If you're confident in your editing and think you'd be a great addition to the crew, send us your portfolio and introduce yourself. We'd love to meet you.

title: Supply Chain Lead for Dropshipping Multi-Ecom Stores
description:
Supply Chain Manager — Shopify Dropshipping | High-SKU Operations | $1,200–$1,500/month



PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING: ONLY APPLY IF YOU MEET ALL THE REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS.



We are specifically looking for someone who has already managed and proactively improved supply chain operations in a high-volume, high-SKU dropshipping business.



If your experience is limited to order processing, tracking shipments, following up with suppliers, customer service, general logistics, or warehouse inventory management, this position is not the right fit.



We are not looking for someone to learn dropshipping supply chain management on the job.



ABOUT US



We are a global e-commerce company operating a growing portfolio of 30+ Shopify stores, primarily in fashion, jewellery, and homeware.



We work with China-based suppliers and fulfillment agents, shipping to customers across Europe and other international markets.



We're hiring an experienced Supply Chain Manager who can lead our supply chain team, remain hands-on with daily operations, and proactively develop and optimize our supply chain processes.



 ABOUT THE ROLE



- Remote, full-time, long-term position

- Monthly compensation: USD $1,200–$1,500

- Manage 2 direct reports

- Approximately 50% hands-on operations and 50% team management and process improvement

- Report directly to the Operations Manager

- Work closely with the Customer Service Manager



You will be accountable for the performance of the supply chain department, not just the completion of daily tasks.



KPIs YOU WILL OWN



- Order processing time: Under 3 days

- Delivery time: Under 10 days

- Out-of-stock (OOS) save rate: Above 80%

- Fulfillment rate:Above 98%

- Product and inventory health: No more than 3% of inventory requiring follow-up



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Hands-On Supply Chain Operations



- Manage a share of daily order processing, fulfillment exceptions, supplier coordination, and OOS cases.

- Resolve delayed orders, stalled shipments, address issues, lost parcels, returns to sender, and product quality concerns.

- Work directly with China-based suppliers and fulfillment agents to resolve sourcing and dispatch issues.

- Monitor product availability and ensure every unresolved issue has a clear owner and deadline.

- Coordinate with Customer Service to ensure order issues are resolved efficiently.



2. Team Management and Leadership



- Directly manage and develop 2 supply chain team members.

- Allocate daily workloads based on priorities, capacity, and operational urgency.

- Set expectations, deadlines, individual KPIs, and accountability.

- Monitor team performance, provide coaching, and address underperformance.

- Collaborate with Customer Service and other departments to achieve shared operational targets.

- Identify capacity constraints and escalate risks with clear recommendations.



3. Proactive Supply Chain Optimization



**This is one of the most important parts of the role.**



We need someone who has previously identified supply chain weaknesses and personally implemented improvements that delivered measurable results.



You will:



- Investigate recurring fulfillment delays, OOS issues, supplier failures, and delivery exceptions.

- Identify root causes rather than repeatedly reacting to the same problems.

- Develop preventive processes to reduce operational issues before they affect customers.

- Improve supplier performance, product availability monitoring, and order fulfillment workflows.

- Design and implement scalable processes for high-SKU, multi-store operations.

- Identify automation opportunities and work on implementing practical solutions.

- Measure the impact of improvements through clear before-and-after KPIs.



4. Reporting and Performance Management



- Monitor and report daily KPI performance, exceptions, urgent risks, and corrective actions.

- Conduct weekly reviews of operational performance, root causes, and improvement initiatives.

- Develop a prioritized improvement plan with clear owners, deadlines, and measurable outcomes.

- Work with the Operations Manager to continuously improve supply chain performance.



MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS — ALL MUST BE MET



**Please do not apply unless you meet every requirement below.**



1. Direct high-volume, high-SKU dropshipping experience. 

You must have personally worked in supply chain operations for a dropshipping company handling substantial order volumes and large product catalogs.



2. Proven supply chain optimization experience.

You must have personally developed, improved, or optimized dropshipping supply chain processes. Simply handling daily operational issues does not qualify.



3. Demonstrable KPI improvements.

You must be able to provide specific examples of improvements you delivered, including the starting KPI, actions taken, and measurable results.



4. Direct people management experience.

You must have managed direct reports, assigned workloads, monitored performance, coached team members, and held them accountable for results. Training colleagues alone does not qualify.



5. Hands-on supplier and fulfillment experience.

You must understand China-based sourcing, fulfillment agents, OOS management, supplier coordination, international shipping, and order exceptions.



6. Proactive problem-solving ability.

You must have experience identifying root causes and implementing preventive solutions, not just following up on problems after they occur.



7. Strong data and reporting skills.

You must be proficient in Google Sheets or Excel and experienced in operational KPI tracking, root-cause analysis, and daily/weekly reporting.



8. Excellent written and spoken English.

You must be able to communicate clearly with management, team members, suppliers, and other departments.



 STRONG ADVANTAGES



- Multi-store Shopify dropshipping experience

- High-SKU fashion or apparel operations

- Experience with CJdropshipping or similar China-based fulfillment agents

- Experience with ParcelPanel, 17TRACK, or similar tracking tools

- Experience building dashboards, automated alerts, or operational workflows

- Experience serving European, UK, US, Canadian, or Australian markets



 YOUR FIRST MONTH



During your first month, you will:



- Work alongside both team members to understand current processes and operational challenges.

- Review live orders, supplier workflows, and existing KPI performance.

- Take ownership of a share of daily operational work.

- Identify the biggest causes of delays, OOS issues, and fulfillment inefficiencies.

- Present an evidence-based improvement plan to the Operations Manager, including actions, owners, timelines, and measurable targets.



HOW TO APPLY — STRICT SCREENING



Start your proposal with the exact words "Supply Chain Lead".



Applications that do not follow this instruction will not be considered.



Please include:



1. **CV:** Your updated resume.



2. **Dropshipping experience:** Which dropshipping companies have you worked for? Which suppliers or fulfillment agents did you use?



3. **Operational scale:** What was the approximate number of active SKUs, Shopify stores, and daily orders you were personally responsible for?



4. **Proven optimization:** Describe ONE supply chain problem you proactively identified and solved. Include:

   - The original problem and root cause

   - The KPI before your improvement

   - What you personally implemented

   - The KPI after your improvement



5. **People management:** How many people directly reported to you, for how long, and how did you allocate workloads and manage their performance?



6. **Expected salary:** Your expected monthly compensation in USD.





IMPORTANT: 

Generic proposals, AI-generated responses without specific supporting examples, and applications that do not demonstrate the mandatory experience will not be shortlisted.



We are looking for someone who has already done this work successfully, can demonstrate their results, and is ready to take ownership of a growing dropshipping supply chain operation.



**Only apply if you genuinely meet ALL the mandatory requirements.**

You own the plan. You keep deadlines reliable, make sure nobody waits for an answer, and turn a fast-moving team into a well-organised one. This is an ownership role: if a deadline slips, you saw it coming and did something about it.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- The plan and the deadlines: every project and recurring task in Asana has an owner, a date and a status that's true, and risks are flagged before a deadline is missed.

- The weekly runs, done right: new product tests, rollouts of winners to every market, creative batches and iterations, on time and checked before they go live.

- Nobody blocked: during the working day you answer within the hour, and nothing waits overnight. You clear blockers yourself or escalate them with a clear ask.

- Onboarding: a new person has their access, documents and first tasks within 48 hours of starting.

- Every system runnable by someone else: for each system and automation we run, a map entry, a short runbook, a backup person and a regular check that it still works. A system isn't finished until someone other than its builder has run it from the documentation.

- The rhythm: daily updates, a weekly review of the plan and the numbers, decisions written down.

- Written procedures for every recurring task, so anyone on the team can run it.

- The people doing the work: launch specialists, VAs and creative partners, briefed, followed up and their work checked.



WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- A track record of running a team's plan and getting work delivered on time without being chased, with numbers to show for it.

- Real mastery of a work-management tool (Asana, ClickUp or similar): structure, recurring tasks, rules that keep it trustworthy.

- SOPs and runbooks that other people actually use, including for systems you didn't build yourself.

- Technical literacy: automations, APIs, spreadsheets, AI tools. You don't need to code, but you can follow how a system works, ask its builder the right questions and test it yourself.

- A quality reflex: you catch errors before they go live, even at high volume.

- Experience leading remote specialists or VAs: clear briefs, quality checks, feedback that sticks.

- E-commerce experience (Shopify, and enough of Meta Ads Manager to check a launch went live), or the speed to learn it in weeks.

- Reliable, regular working hours that overlap 09:00–18:00 Paris time (CET). Being reachable is part of the job.



YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS

- Month 1: the plan is reliable, the weekly runs happen on time, and nobody waits for an answer.

- Month 2: every system is on the map with its owner and a health check, and the most important ones have runbooks.

- Month 3: every system has a runbook and a backup person who has run it at least once.



HOW YOU'LL BE MEASURED

Run tasks done on their due day, a plan with no undated or silently overdue tasks, how fast people get answers, how fast new people are up and running, launches that pass checks the first time, and every system with a runbook and a backup person.



COMPENSATION

$3,000–5,000 a month depending on experience, plus a performance bonus. We're optimising for the right person, not the cheapest one.



HOW TO APPLY

Don't send a generic cover letter. Answer these:



1. What's the most complex plan you've personally run? Tell us the business, team size, number of projects or recurring tasks, and what you were responsible for.



2. Tell us about a time you got a team to deliver on time, every week, without having to chase them. What did you put in place, and what changed? Give numbers.



3. You take over an Asana workspace with about 60 open tasks. A third have no due date, several are overdue, and the recurring weekly tasks have no dates at all. How do you structure it, and which rules keep it trustworthy from then on?



4. How do you check work before it goes live when the volume is high, for example 100+ ad campaigns or product pages a week? Tell us about a costly error you caught in time.



5. Imagine you join on a Monday. Several validated products are weeks late rolling out to 40 markets. A dozen creative batches are due today and none is done. Teammates are waiting on answers in Slack, and nobody has a full map of the 30+ systems and automations the team runs. What do you do in your first 5 days? Be specific.



6. A teammate is fast and hard-working but disorganised: deadlines slip, steps get skipped, and work needs correcting before it goes live. How do you get reliable output from them within a month?



7. Tell us about a system or process someone else built that you documented so a new person could run it without help. How did you get the information out of the builder, and how did you check the documentation actually worked?



8. Tell us about a time you dropped the ball. What happened, and what did you change?



9. Which tools do you use every day, and how well? (Asana or ClickUp, Slack, Notion or Google Docs, Sheets or Excel, Shopify, Meta Ads Manager, AI tools)



10. Your current situation: where you're based, current role, whether you can work regular hours overlapping 09:00–18:00 Paris time (CET), compensation expectations, and when you could start.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid practical exercise using real, anonymised material from our business.

title: $500/Month — Wedding Video Editor | Paid Training, Constant Work, Weekly Pay | Long-Term
description:
We are a wedding-video business looking for reliable Adobe Premiere Pro editors who want a long-term position and a steady flow of paid work.



THE JOB OFFER



• Ongoing wedding-video editing in small, clearly defined assignments

• Weekly payment through PayPal for approved work

• An average of US$500 per month

• A clear path from a short skills assessment to paid training and then regular paid work with our team



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



• Working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro

• A Windows PC suitable for running Adobe Premiere Pro; this workflow is PC-based

• Ability to receive payments through PayPal

• Careful attention to instructions and detail

• Fast, dependable delivery and responsive communication

• Conversational English

• Availability Monday–Friday, 09:00–14:00 GMT+3, during training. After training, you can work whenever you like, as long as you meet all deadlines.

• Willingness to ask questions and report progress



Previous wedding or multicamera editing experience is welcome, but it is not required. Some of our best editors joined us without any wedding-editing experience.



STEP 1: SHORT SKILLS ASSESSMENT



Shortlisted candidates complete a brief paid editing assessment before training, for which you will be paid. The assessment uses real wedding footage from a project that was completed and delivered several years ago. You will not send us the Adobe Premiere Pro project file. You will submit only timeline screenshots and low-quality video renders so we can review the timing of your cuts, the beats, and which shots you selected—nothing more. The assessment consists of an already synced five-minute multicam timeline and a 30-second reception timeline and should take approximately 10 minutes of editing time if you have some experience editing in Adobe Premiere Pro. It is used to confirm that you can understand the workflow, follow instructions accurately, communicate well, and deliver on time.



STEP 2: PAID TRAINING



Candidates who pass the test enter paid training. You receive access to our learning platform, training videos, tutorials, and guidance from a personal tutor during the training hours above. Training continues until you reach the editing standard required for ongoing work. The training rate and milestones will be confirmed before training begins.



ONGOING PAID WORK AND CONTINUED TRAINING



Once you complete the initial training, you will begin receiving a constant flow of paid wedding-video assignments with synced material and clear instructions. Our syncers handle synchronization, our ML system supplies the preprocessed multicam, you vet the result, and our QC team reviews the complete multicam.



The learning does not stop when the paid work begins. Your real assignments will go hand in hand with continued training as you learn every part of our wedding-video workflow. You will progress step by step through the different types of edits until you reach the highest level: creating complete wedding highlights.



We are looking for editors who want to stay, improve, take on more responsibility, and become long-term members of our team.



HOW TO APPLY



1. Start your application with the word CEREMONY so we know you read the full post.

2. Include a 30-second audio introduction. This is required so we can assess your spoken English.

3. Confirm that you work on a Windows PC.

4. Confirm that you can receive payments through PayPal.

5. Confirm that you can be available Monday–Friday, 09:00–14:00 GMT+3, during paid training.

6. If you have edited wedding videos before, you are welcome to include one link to your best wedding highlight. This is optional; previous wedding-editing experience is not required.

, TikTok, YouTube, and LinkedIn

title: VIDEO EDITOR FULL TIME
description:
Please watch: 



Multi 9-Figures Supplement Brand Hiring | Video Editor | Performance Creative

We're one of the fastest-growing 9-figure all-natural supplement brands in the market. Brands you know swipe our ads every single day. Meta is our primary channel, and we need a video editor to turn our briefs into the ads that help us double spend over the next 12 months.

Start: ASAP.

This is a performance editing seat.

Why this seat is different

Most editing jobs treat you as a pair of hands. You get a brief, you get paired with a mid strategist, you produce their videos, and you rarely ever find out what happened. No data, no credit, no upside and no future career advancement.

This seat works the opposite way. You see exactly how every edit performs. You own each video start to finish. When your edits win, your pay goes up with them.



Not just that - we also work very closely with you to make sure you hit your career goals. If you want to be a creative strategist 6 months down the line, we will train you to get there.



If you want to have your own video editing pod, we can help you get there. 



If you want to own the entire video department, we can help you get there.



If you want to double or triple your current income, we can help you get there. 





The role

Our creative strategists write the briefs. You turn them into finished ads. Every winner starts as a script and ends in your timeline.

Take creative briefs with reference videos and turn them into finished ads

Build across formats: AI movie ads, Pixar-style ads, claymation, singing ads, skeleton ads, and whatever starts working next. We'll train you on any format you haven't done before. (You don’t need to know all of these but it is a big plus)

Take full ownership of every video you make. Its performance has your name on it, and your bonus is tied to it.

Who you are

Detail-obsessed. Hook timing, caption clarity, pacing, and sound design all matter to you. The gap between a winner and an almost-winner is usually detail.

Fast. You ship high volume without sloppy work. You'd rather deliver a v1 today than a "perfect" cut next week.

Self-starter. You take a brief and run with it. We won't micromanage you. You like owning concepts. 

Fluent in AI tools. You already use them in your workflow and you pick up new ones quickly.

Obsessed with ads that sell. E-commerce or DTC ad experience is a plus. If you don't have it, you need to be actively studying the ads that do.

What you get

Fully remote, flexible hours

Competitive base + performance bonus 

Upgraded bonus months (some months where you can be paid 2x more bonus)

Full visibility into the data, so you see exactly how your edits perform

Direct access to top-performing strategists, if you want to grow your career

Clear progression into lead video editor or creative strategist 

Clear paybumps if performance is good

Best-in-the-game training on ads and video editing

How to apply

Fill out the form: 

The code word is "Meta", so we know you read the whole post.

Hiring process

Application form

Founder and head of video review your form

Paid test task 

Final interview

You get your offer letter

What we value

Output, accountability, and a thirst for knowledge. If these don't fit, we won't either.

If you want predictable 9-to-5 work, we're not a fit. If you want your edits to drive a 9-figure brand, apply.

title: Senior Accountant — Singapore F&B Group
description:
IMPORTANT: Please apply only if you have hands-on experience working with Singapore-based companies and a strong understanding of Singapore accounting, GST, corporate tax, IRAS compliance, and statutory requirements.



We are looking for an experienced Senior Accountant based in the Philippines to manage accounting, tax compliance, and financial reporting for our Singapore-based F&B group.



Our group operates multiple brands, legal entities, and outlets. Routine bookkeeping is supported by an in-house finance team and AI-assisted systems, so your primary responsibility will be to review the numbers, ensure regulatory compliance, and deliver accurate financial reports.



This role is ideal for an accountant with strong Singapore accounting experience who can independently manage GST, IRAS compliance, multi-entity accounts, and monthly financial reporting.



Key Responsibilities

-Singapore Tax and Statutory Compliance

-Prepare and file quarterly Singapore GST returns (Form F5).

-Manage GST reconciliations, input tax claims, and F&B-specific GST issues.

-Handle IRAS queries and support tax audits.

-Manage corporate tax compliance, including ECI and Form C/C-S, and coordinate ACRA annual filings.

-Review payroll-related statutory submissions, including CPF, SDL, SHG, and IR8A/AIS.

-Multi-Entity Accounting

-Manage full-set accounts across multiple Singapore entities.

-Handle intercompany transactions, loans, trade balances, and reconciliations.

-Prepare consolidation entries and shared-cost allocations, including central kitchen costs and management fees.

-Monthly Financial Reporting

-Deliver monthly management accounts by the seventh working day.

-Prepare P&Ls by brand, legal entity, and outlet.

-Monitor COGS, labour costs, prime cost, and stocktake variances.

-Prepare budget-versus-actual analysis and cash flow forecasts.

-Identify discrepancies and recommend improvements to financial controls.

-Finance Review and Controls

-Review sales reconciliations across POS, bank, card, PayNow, GrabPay, and food delivery platforms.

-Investigate platform payout differences, commissions, and promotional deductions.

-Review payroll, accounts payable/receivable, and routine bookkeeping prepared by the support team.



Requirements

-Degree in Accountancy.

-CA Singapore or ACCA qualified, or actively progressing toward qualification.

-At least five years of full-set accounting experience, including substantial hands-on Singapore accounting.

-At least three years supporting a multi-entity, multi-outlet F&B or retail group.

-Proven experience preparing and filing Singapore GST returns.

-Strong working knowledge of SFRS, Singapore corporate tax, CPF, and foreign worker levy rules.

-Experience with Xero, QuickBooks Online, or similar cloud accounting systems.

-Strong Excel skills and the ability to explain financial results clearly.



Nice to Have

-Experience with a central kitchen and shared-cost allocation.

-Experience supporting GST audits or voluntary disclosures.

-Experience with Singapore F&B groups operating 10 or more outlets.

-Familiarity with AI-assisted accounting and automation tools.



Working Arrangement

-Fully remote, based in the Philippines.

-Full-time role supporting Singapore operations.

-Must be available for agreed working hours with Singapore time-zone overlap.



Compensation will depend on relevant Singapore accounting experience and qualifications.

title: Supply Chain Analyst
description:
About the Role

We are a jewellery and accessories brand with a growing e-commerce and retail presence. We’re looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to keep our product in stock and moving. You will own the flow of inventory from purchase order to warehouse shelf — placing POs with suppliers, managing inbound shipments, reconciling invoices, and building the reporting that tells the team what we have, what is coming, and where we are at risk of stocking out.



This is a hands-on role that sits between our suppliers, our warehouse partner, and our finance and e-commerce teams. You will work daily in Shopify, Looker, and Sage, and you will be the go-to person for accurate, up-to-date inventory information.



Work Structure & Requirements



🏠 Location: Remote / Virtual

📅 Schedule: Full-time

🌏 Time Zone: EST business hours

💵 Compensation: $8 USD per hour



Key Responsibilities



1. Purchasing & Supplier Management



Place purchase orders with suppliers based on demand, current stock, and lead times

Track and manage inbound delivery dates, following up with suppliers to keep shipments on schedule

Flag delays or supply risks early and work with the team on solutions



2. Item Master & New Product Setup



Own and maintain the item master, keeping SKU data accurate and consistent across Shopify, Sage, and warehouse systems

Set up UPCs and all required product information for new launch products at the time of ordering

Ensure new items are fully set up before their first PO is placed and inbounded

Partner with product development to get SKUs approved in time for PO placement



3. Inbound & Warehouse Operations



Create and upload Advance Shipping Notices (ASNs) to our warehouse partner for every inbound shipment

Manage the receiving process end-to-end, from arrival through receipt confirmation

Resolve discrepancies between what was ordered, shipped, and received



4. Invoice Reconciliation



Review all supplier invoices and match them against purchase orders and receipts

Approve accurate invoices for payment and route exceptions to finance with clear context



5. Inventory Reporting & Analysis



Build and maintain reporting in Looker, Shopify, and Sage to give the team a clear view of inventory health

Analyse stockouts to understand root causes and recommend changes to prevent them

Maintain daily reporting on inbound shipments and inventory levels

Communicate inventory status, risks, and changes proactively to stakeholders across the business



6. Process Improvement & Automation



Drive efficiency by using AI tools to automate manual processes across purchasing, receiving, invoicing, and reporting



Required Skills & Experience



Experience: 3+ years in supply chain, inventory, purchasing, or operations — ideally in e-commerce or consumer products

Systems: ⚠️ Experience using ERP systems required; Shopify, Looker, and Sage (or similar e-commerce, BI, and accounting tools) strongly preferred

Purchasing: ⚠️ Hands-on experience placing POs and managing inbound shipments with suppliers and a 3PL or warehouse

Data: Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills including pivot tables, lookups, and recurring reports; comfortable reconciling data across systems and identifying discrepancies

Communication: Clear, proactive communication with suppliers, warehouse partners, and internal teams

Attention to Detail: Able to manage multiple shipments and deadlines simultaneously with high accuracy



Nice to Have



Experience with Airtable and SKU setup

Familiarity with ASNs, receiving workflows, and three-way matching (PO, receipt, invoice)

Experience with demand forecasting or reorder-point planning

Experience working on an ERP implementation project

Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, business, finance, or a related field

title: Procurement Officer
description:
Full-Time Procurement Officer  – Construction



About Ultrabuild Construction Group

Ultrabuild Construction Group is an Australian building company delivering residential and commercial projects. We’re a busy, growing team, and we’re looking for a reliable, detail-focused Procurement VA to join us long-term and help keep our jobs supplied, on budget and on schedule.



The role

You’ll be the link between our project managers, suppliers and subcontractors. You’ll make sure the right materials and trades are ordered at the right price and arrive on time. This is a full-time, long-term remote position working directly with the team.



Your responsibilities

Quotes and pricing

• Send quote requests to suppliers and subcontractors using job plans, scopes and estimates provided by our estimators and project managers

• Follow up outstanding quotes so pricing comes back on time

• Compare quotes side by side, checking that inclusions, exclusions, quantities and lead times line up, and summarise the options for the project manager

• Check quoted prices against our estimates and price lists, and flag anything over budget before it’s approved

• Keep supplier price lists current and record price increases as they come in

Purchase orders and ordering

• Prepare and send purchase orders once quotes are approved, making sure each order is linked to the correct job and cost code

• Confirm order details with suppliers, including quantities, delivery addresses, site access and delivery dates

• Plan orders around the build schedule so materials and trades are booked ahead of each stage (e.g. slab, frame, lock-up, fit-off)

• Raise variation purchase orders when scope changes, and update job costs to match

Deliveries and follow-up

• Track open orders and confirm delivery dates with suppliers in the days before each delivery

• Chase late deliveries and backorders, and let the site team know early if delays will affect the schedule

• Arrange returns, credits or replacements for damaged, incorrect or excess materials

• Keep the project manager updated on order status for each job

Supplier and subcontractor management

• Set up new suppliers and subcontractors, and keep their contact, payment and account details up to date

• Collect and track compliance documents such as public liability insurance, workers’ compensation, licences and safety documents (SWMS), and follow up before anything expires

• Build good working relationships with our regular suppliers and trades

• Help find and get quotes from new suppliers when needed

Admin and reporting

• Keep clear and organised records in our job management software (Wunderbuild) and accounting software (Xero)

• Prepare regular reports on open orders, upcoming deliveries, outstanding quotes and expiring compliance documents

• Manage the procurement inbox and respond to supplier
s promptly

• Help improve our procurement processes, templates and checklists over time



Requirements

• At least [2] years’ experience in procurement, purchasing or admin. Construction experience is a big plus.

• Excellent written and spoken English, with the confidence to deal directly with Australian suppliers

• Strong attention to detail with numbers, quantities and pricing

• Well organised and able to manage several projects at once

• Able to work independently and ask questions when something doesn’t add up

• Able to work Australian business hours (e.g.8:00am – 5:00pm AEST)

• A reliable internet connection, a backup connection or power source, and a quiet workspace



Nice to have

• Experience with Australian construction or building companies

• Experience with construction software (Wunderbuild, Buildxact, Procore or similar)

• Knowledge of building materials and construction terms

• Understanding of Australian GST and invoicing



What we offer

• Competitive salary based on experience

• Long-term, stable remote position

• Opportunity to work directly with an Australian construction business

• Supportive team environment



How to apply

Please submit your resume along with a short summary telling us about your procurement or purchasing experience

Start your application with the words “Ultrabuild Procurement” so we know you’ve read the full ad. Applications without this will not be considered

title: Procreate Artist Wanted — Flexible Part-Time Work & Long-Term Collaboration
description:
We’re looking for a Procreate artist to create illustrations with our brush sets and record the drawing process.



We provide the visual concepts, references, and brushes, so you can focus on bringing the artwork to life. We’re looking for someone we can work with regularly and grow with over time.



WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

• Flexible, fully remote work — choose your own hours and deliver in agreed batches.

• Around one hour a day on average to start — suitable alongside other projects or studies.

• Nearly finished visual concepts — no need to develop every idea from scratch.

• A paid test to see whether the work is a good fit for both sides.

• Long-term opportunities, with workload and compensation reviewed regularly.



THE CREATIVE WORK

For each assignment, we provide a nearly finished visual concept with the subject, composition, color palette, and overall direction already established, along with the Procreate brushes to use.



Your role is to recreate the reference with the agreed level of visual impact, texture, color, and finish. Thoughtful creative suggestions are welcome where they improve the result.



You’ll work with different Procreate brush sets, so illustration styles, techniques, and complexity will vary between assignments.



We’ll share sample concepts and links to artwork and drawing-process references with shortlisted applicants. These will help us agree on the visual quality, recording approach, workload, and pricing before starting.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

We’re particularly interested in artists who can adapt to different illustration styles and make good use of expressive brushwork. Your portfolio matters more to us than a particular job title or number of years of experience.



You should be comfortable working with supplied brushes, following a clear visual direction, and keeping your Procreate files organized and editable. Additional brushes, imported assets, or significant modifications to our brushes should be agreed upon beforehand.



RECORDING THE DRAWING PROCESS

The recording is just as important as the finished illustration. We’ll use the footage in promotional content showcasing our brushes, so it needs to clearly capture how the artwork develops and how the tools are used.



We’ll agree on practical recording guidelines before you start, including canvas positioning, zooming and rotation, visibility of brush names, and keeping notifications and unrelated activity off-screen.



FOR EACH ILLUSTRATION, YOU’LL DELIVER

• A finished, high-resolution PNG.

• An editable .procreate file with organized layers.

• A full, real-time iPad screen recording, including all drawing sessions.

• The full-length Procreate timelapse.

• A short list of the brushes used, with their names clearly visible when selected in the recording.



OPTIONAL: FILMING THE DRAWING PROCESS

If you can also film selected artworks with a camera positioned above and slightly to the side of the iPad, showing both the screen and your hand drawing, that would be a big plus. We’re looking for clear, well-lit footage with stable framing and minimal glare.



Camera filming is optional and paid extra. We’ll agree on the requirements and additional fee beforehand. You’re welcome to apply even if you can only provide screen recordings.



WORKLOAD & PAY

Our starting target is approximately 30 illustrations with process recordings per month, with an initial budget of around US$300.



The illustrations will vary in complexity: a simple piece might take 15–20 minutes, while a more detailed one could take around two hours. We’ll agree on a balanced mix, aiming for an overall workload of roughly one hour per day on average, including recording, exports, and delivery.



The budget and volume are starting points, not fixed terms. Rates, complexity, deadlines, and workload will be discussed individually based on your skills, portfolio, working speed, and availability. More demanding pieces will be priced separately or accounted for in the batch price.



We’ll use the paid test to establish realistic expectations together. You can work whenever suits you — what matters is delivering the agreed work within the agreed deadlines.



CLEAR DIRECTION & FOCUSED FEEDBACK

We agree on the visual direction before drawing begins to keep creative guesswork and revisions to a minimum. Any necessary adaptations should be discussed in advance.



One round of minor revisions within the agreed brief is included. Significant changes to an approved concept or scope are discussed separately.



LONG-TERM COLLABORATION & GROWTH

We’re looking for a lasting creative partnership with someone who can become familiar with our brushes and visual approach.



As the project grows, we plan to offer more work, introduce more advanced assignments, and increase compensation accordingly. We’ll review rates and workload regularly by mutual agreement, with any increase in responsibilities discussed in advance.



INTERESTED? SEND US

• 3–5 Procreate artworks, ideally showing different styles.

• A drawing-process recording, if you have one — this would be a big plus.

• Your availability and a brief note about your relevant experience.

• Confirmation that you can work with our brushes and provide the required recordings and layered files.

• A sample of camera footage, if you’d like to offer that option.



We’ll discuss time estimates and pricing after sharing the references with you.



A short introduction and relevant work samples are enough — no lengthy cover letter needed. We’ll start with one paid test illustration and, if we’re a good fit, move on to a small batch and regular collaboration.
