title: Multi-Channel E-commerce Manager - Amazon, TIktok
description:
Hypersonic Wholesale Ltd runs consumer brands across Amazon UK, TikTok Shop, Shopify, Temu and eBay, and is hiring a Multi-Channel E-commerce Manager to own the day-to-day running of every marketplace account. Immediate start.

You will be the single owner of account health, listings, compliance, cases and customer messages across all platforms, reporting directly to the founder. The core focus is Amazon and TikTok Shop, with Temu, Shopify and eBay alongside.



Key responsibilities

You own these across every platform unless stated otherwise.

Account health and compliance

• Monitor account health daily on every marketplace and act before metrics breach thresholds (Amazon AHR, ODR, late shipment; TikTok Shop response rate, LDR, violation points; eBay seller standards)

• Handle all policy notifications, violations, warnings and appeals, including drafting and submitting appeals with evidence

• Keep product compliance documentation current: ingredients, labelling, safety and certifications (particularly for pet treats and confectionery), plus any platform-specific compliance requirements such as GPSR, responsible person and category approvals

• Manage IP, brand registry and trademark matters on each platform

Case and dispute management

• Open, chase and resolve all seller support cases: listing errors, lost or damaged inventory, reimbursements, suppressed listings, account issues

• Keep a tracker of open cases with status and next action, and escalate to the founder only when a decision is needed

Listings and catalogue

• Create, upload and maintain product listings on every platform: titles, bullets, descriptions, A+ and brand content, images, variations, attributes and keywords

• Keep pricing, stock levels and promotions consistent across channels

• Set up new product launches end to end, including TikTok Shop product cards and affiliate samples

• Audit listings regularly for suppressed items, missing attributes and conversion issues, and fix them

Customer messages and reviews

• Answer all customer messages across every platform within platform SLAs (TikTok Shop and Amazon 24-hour response rate must stay above 90%)

• Manage returns, refunds, replacements and A-to-Z claims

• Monitor reviews and ratings, respond where appropriate and flag product or supplier issues

Inventory and fulfilment

• Create and manage FBA shipments, monitor inbound and stranded inventory, and flag reorder points

• Monitor TikTok Shop fulfilment and dispatch performance and coordinate with the warehouse team on any late orders

Advertising and promotions

• Day-to-day management of Amazon PPC and TikTok Shop ads campaigns: bids, budgets, negative keywords and reporting

• Set up deals, coupons, Prime Day and seasonal promotions across channels

Reporting and improvement

• Weekly report to the founder covering sales, account health, open cases, ad spend and what you changed

• Proactively bring ideas for improving sales, efficiency and account health, including how AI tools can automate or speed up the work

• Document SOPs for recurring tasks so processes do not live in one person's head

Must have

• 2+ years hands-on experience managing an Amazon Seller Central account (FBA), including listings, cases, account health and PPC

• 1+ years hands-on experience managing a TikTok Shop seller account, including Seller Center, Shop Chat, affiliate and campaign tools

• Completed relevant training in Amazon and TikTok Shop selling (please list courses or certifications in your application)

• Previous customer service experience, handling customer messages, complaints and returns to a deadline

• Working knowledge of Shopify, eBay and Temu seller tools, or the ability to pick them up fast

• Confident with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or similar) for drafting listings, replies, appeals and SOPs, and able to suggest where AI can improve how we work

• Takes initiative: spots problems before being told, fixes what can be fixed, and comes to the founder with options rather than questions

• Highly organised with a tracker for everything, strong written English, and comfortable working remotely with minimal supervision

• Available to start immediately



Nice to have

• Graphic design ability (Canva, Photoshop or AI image tools) for listing images, A+ content and TikTok Shop assets

• Experience in pet, food or confectionery categories, or with regulated product compliance

• Experience with Amazon Brand Registry, IP complaints and trademark matters

• Experience with Amazon Ads or TikTok Ads beyond basic campaign management

• Familiarity with GoHighLevel, Notion or similar tools



Hours and availability

This is a full-time role: 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday, 8 hours per day within UK business hours (approximately 9am to 5pm UK time), with a short daily inbox check in the morning so no customer message waits overnight.

Weekends: Marketplace SLAs run seven days a week. We ask for a brief check of customer messages and account notifications once on Saturday and once on Sunday (typically 15 to 30 minutes) to answer anything urgent. This is a light-touch commitment and will be reflected in the salary.



Communication: Daily end-of-day update in Slack or WhatsApp, weekly report and call with the founder.

How to apply



Send a CV and a short covering message

Your Social Currency is a London content agency. We make content for big creators, some with over a million followers. We are growing fast, and we need one developer who owns all the small tools that make our team faster.



WHAT YOU WILL BUILD

Most builds are "this API, that API, an LLM in the middle, put it live". We tell you the idea in plain words. You build it, put it live and keep it working.



WHAT YOU NEED

- You have built real tools that pull data from an API and do something useful with an LLM (Claude, GPT or similar).

NICE TO HAVE

# Inside Sales Representative – U.S. Market (Remote, Philippines)



**Payco Enterprises, Inc. | Full-Time | $5.00 USD/Hour + Uncapped Commissions + Performance Bonuses**



## Do You Live on the Phone? Are You a Natural Salesperson?



Payco is a growing U.S.-based fintech and commerce technology company seeking motivated, experienced sales professionals in the Philippines to join our inside sales team.



We provide businesses throughout the United States with credit card processing, point-of-sale (POS) systems, IT support, e-commerce solutions, and integrated business technology.



We're looking for individuals who are confident on the phone, comfortable speaking with American business owners, and motivated by performance-based compensation.



Your initial focus will be generating qualified sales appointments while developing the knowledge and skills necessary to manage the complete sales process and independently close deals.



**This is a performance-driven sales position. Representatives are required to close a minimum of 8 qualifying merchant accounts per month to maintain employment, subject to applicable employment laws.**



## Schedule and Work Arrangement



- **Location:** Remote – Philippines

- **Schedule:** Monday–Thursday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM; Friday, 9:00 AM–4:00 PM (U.S. Pacific Time)

- **Hours:** 35 paid hours per week, with a 30-minute unpaid lunch Monday through Thursday and a one-hour unpaid lunch Friday

- **Employment:** Full-time remote position

- **Base Pay:** $5.00 USD per hour

- **Approximate Monthly Base:** $758.33 USD, plus commissions and bonuses



Candidates must be available during scheduled U.S. Pacific Time business hours.



## Responsibilities



- Make high-volume outbound calls to U.S. businesses using our VoIP system and power dialer.

- Reach business owners and decision-makers, navigate gatekeepers, and introduce Payco's solutions.

- Identify opportunities to reduce processing costs and improve business operations.

- Schedule qualified appointments with prospective merchants.

- Request processing statements for cost analyses and sales presentations.

- Conduct discovery calls, handle objections, and present customized solutions.

- Close merchant processing, POS, and technology agreements over the phone.

- Follow up consistently with prospective clients.

- Maintain accurate CRM records, prospect information, and sales activity.

- Manage opportunities from initial contact through account activation.



## Performance Expectations



- 200+ outbound dialing attempts per day

- 15+ decision-maker conversations per day

- 10+ qualified appointments scheduled per week

- 80%+ appointment attendance rate

- Accurate and timely CRM updates

- **Minimum 8 qualifying closed merchant accounts per month**



**Maintaining a minimum of 8 qualifying closed deals per month is an ongoing employment requirement, subject to applicable employment laws.**



## Compensation and Commissions



**Base Pay: $5.00 USD per hour**



Commissions are paid on qualifying merchant accounts personally closed, based on monthly processing volume.



| Monthly Merchant Processing Volume | Commission |

|---|---:|

| $10,000 or less | $0 |

| Over $10,000 but under $25,000 | $20 |

| $25,000–$49,999.99 | $50 |

| $50,000–$100,000 | $100 |

| Over $100,000 through $200,000 | $200 |

| Over $200,000 but under $500,000 | $250 |

| $500,000 and above | $350 |



Accounts processing $10,000 or less per month do not qualify for commissions or monthly deal-count bonuses.



Qualifying accounts processing more than $10,000 but less than $25,000 earn a $20 commission and may count toward the monthly quota and bonus thresholds, up to a maximum of 3 such accounts per month.



### Monthly Performance Bonuses



- **8–11 closed deals:** $250 bonus

- **12 or more closed deals:** Additional $500 bonus

- **Maximum cumulative monthly bonus:** $750



Commissions are uncapped and paid monthly according to the written commission agreement.



## Earnings Potential



Based on 35 paid hours per week:



- **Monthly Base Salary:** Approximately $758.33 USD

- **Annual Base Salary:** $9,100 USD

- **Additional Earnings:** Uncapped commissions and monthly performance bonuses



For example, closing 8 qualifying deals with an average commission of $200 per account would generate:



- Base Pay: $758.33

- Commissions: $1,600

- Performance Bonus: $250

- **Total Estimated Monthly Earnings: $2,608.33 USD**



Actual earnings depend on performance, eligible accounts, and commission qualifications.



## Qualifications



- Minimum 2 years of outbound calling, telesales, appointment setting, or inside sales experience.

- Experience communicating with U.S. businesses or American customers.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Strong sales, negotiation, and objection-handling skills.

- Experience using VoIP systems, power dialers, and CRM software.

- Self-motivated, disciplined, coachable, and results-oriented.

- Ability to work independently and consistently meet sales expectations.



Experience in merchant services, credit card processing, POS systems, financial services, or B2B technology sales is strongly preferred.



## Remote Work Requirements



- Reliable high-speed internet

- Quiet, professional workspace

- Computer and quality headset

- Availability during U.S. Pacific Time business hours

- Ability to attend virtual training and team meetings



## Why Join Payco?



- $5.00 USD hourly base plus uncapped commissions.

- Monthly performance bonuses up to $750.

- Comprehensive training in payment processing, POS technology, and sales.

- Provided leads, CRM, VoIP system, and sales resources.

## How to Apply

title: Bookkeeper / Accounting Specialist – Vacation Rental Property Management (Xero, TopKey, Trust Accounting)
description:
ABOUT US



We are a growing vacation rental management company in Lake Tahoe, California. We manage more than 100 short-term rental homes for homeowners in California and Nevada, and we plan to keep growing over the next few years. Our books are kept in Xero by an outside CPA firm. We need a hands-on, in-house bookkeeper to own the day-to-day accounting work and act as the point person who keeps trust and operating items moving.



This role is for someone who finishes what they start. You follow up until things are actually resolved, you ask instead of guessing, and you check your own work before anything leaves your desk. Accuracy and follow-through matter more here than almost anywhere else in the company, because homeowners trust us with their money.



SCHEDULE: Full-time, 45 hours per week, Monday–Friday. Night shift in the Philippines covering US Pacific Time business hours (exact hours confirmed at hire). Reliable internet and a quiet workspace required.

SALARY: USD $1,395 per month ($7/hr base for 45 hrs/week, plus a $30/month internet stipend), paid twice monthly on the 15th and 30th

START DATE: ASAP



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Transactions and expenses (daily)

- Review, code, and categorize every company card and bank transaction in TopKey so it is ready to sync to Xero.

- Match receipts to transactions daily, and chase missing receipts and missing details with the cardholder. Don't just leave a comment and wait.

- D
 correctly whether each charge is owner-billable, a company expense, or a pass-through. For example, a permit or repair billed back to a homeowner is not a general company expense.

- Create owner charges in TopKey and push them to our property management system (Streamline). Make sure the posted dates match the statement period.

- Code lodging/occupancy tax (TOT) transactions to the correct accounts every time, following our documented process.



Accounts payable (twice a week)

- Turn invoices from our bills inbox into bills in TopKey and route them for approval under our approval thresholds.

- Before paying anything, check it against the work order, approval, amount, and rate.

- Pay vendors on schedule so nothing goes past due, and keep vendor records up to date.

- Handle recurring payments such as office rent and contractor/VA payments on their due dates.



Trust accounting and reconciliations

- Act as first reviewer on weekly bank and reservation escalations from our CPA firm. Track down what you can, such as a deposit that needs a reservation breakdown or a trust account charge that needs identifying, and keep each item moving until it is closed.

- Support trust (owner funds) reconciliation: work with our CPA, who pre-reconciles the trust account each week, to clear open items. Help clean up older uncleared items.

- Help match Xero bank and credit card feeds against transactions pushed from TopKey, and resolve discrepancies.

- Watch for chargebacks, unpaid owner payouts, and balance-due reservations, including OTA virtual-card payments, and resolve them.



Month-end close and owner statements

- Make sure all TopKey transactions are coded and all owner charges are pushed to Streamline by the 2nd of each month.

- Work the CPA's escalation list (issued on the 3rd business day) until reporting is clean, usually turning items around in 1–2 business days.

- Support the internal owner statement review: cancellations and clawbacks, reservations that cross months, late payments, new-unit commission splits, and owner charges. Statements are approved and owners are paid by the 10th.



Occupancy tax compliance

- Prepare and file transient occupancy/lodging tax returns for several California and Nevada counties and cities, on monthly and quarterly schedules, and send them for review before each due date.

- Help audit tax setups in Streamline (tax IDs, permits, and rates) and flag anything that needs fixing.



Process and documentation

- Keep our bookkeeping checklist and SOPs current. Write a step-by-step SOP or record a short Loom video for every recurring task you own.

- Recommend practical internal controls as we grow.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



- 3+ years of bookkeeping or accounting experience with US clients

- Solid grasp of accrual-based accounting, with real examples you can walk us through

- Experience with cloud accounting software. Xero is preferred; strong QuickBooks Online experience is fine, since Xero is easy to learn from QBO and has free training.

- Bank and credit card reconciliation experience, including what to do when the books don't reconcile and you can't find the difference

- Sales tax or lodging/occupancy tax experience: preparing and filing returns, and booking tax collected as a liability

- You understand the difference between owner-billable, company, and pass-through expenses

- You ask when something is unclear instead of guessing, and you catch and correct your own mistakes

- You follow up proactively. If a teammate isn't getting you information on time, you escalate clearly until the item is closed.

- Tech-savvy and quick to learn new software (our PMS is powerful but complex)

- Strong written English. Most of our communication is by
, Slack, and our accounting portal.

- Organized and consistent with documentation and SOPs

- Available to work the schedule above



THE TECH YOU WILL USE



- Xero (general ledger, bank and card feeds)

- TopKey (company cards, expense coding, receipts, bill pay and approvals, owner charges, Xero sync)

- Streamline (vacation rental property management system: reservations, trust accounting, owner statements, work orders)

- Breezeway (field operations and work orders that flow into TopKey)

- Our CPA firm's client portal (weekly tasks and escalations)

- Lynnbrook (owner payouts and chargeback monitoring)

- Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Sheets)

- Slack

- Notion (documentation)

- Loom (SOP videos)

- Airbnb, Vrbo, and other booking channels (payouts and reservation details)



Streamline experience is a plus but not required.



NICE TO HAVE



- Vacation rental or short-term rental property management bookkeeping experience

- Trust accounting or 3-way reconciliation for client/owner funds

- Experience with TopKey or another expense/bill-pay platform that syncs to Xero or QBO

- Experience with another vacation rental PMS (Guesty, Hostaway, Track, Hospitable, etc.)

- Familiarity with how OTAs (Airbnb, Vrbo) collect and remit occupancy tax

- QuickBooks Online experience in addition to Xero

- A bookkeeping certification, or Xero/QBO certification

- Experience building SOPs and checklists from scratch



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:

1. Your resume

2. A short cover note (1–2 paragraphs) about your experience with Xero or QBO and with sales/lodging tax

3. Your answers to the two questions below



Put the words TAHOE LEDGER in your subject line. Applications without this phrase or without answers to the questions will not be reviewed.



Screening questions

1. A $180 charge from a hardware store shows up on a company card with no receipt and no property listed. Walk us through exactly what you do next, step by step, until it is resolved.

2. You've reconciled a bank account and you're $312.40 off, and you can't find the difference. What do you check, and in what order?



Shortlisted applicants will have a video interview and a short practical test.



We're excited to meet someone who loves clean books as much as we do. Thank you for applying!

title: Part-Time Recruiter / Talent Scout for US Life Insurance Sales Team (Hourly + $150 Bonus Per Hire)
description:
ABOUT US



We are a fast-growing, fully remote life insurance sales team in the United States. Our agency does around $2 million a month in production, and we are expanding aggressively. I am a manager on the team, and my goal is to build the biggest, hardest-working group of agents in the agency.



To do that, I need one thing more than anything else: a constant flow of motivated people who want to join my team. That is where you come in.



THE ROLE



This is a recruiting job. Your one and only job is to find people in the United States who want to become life insurance agents on my team, get them interested, qualify them, and book them on a call with me.



You will not be selling insurance. You will not be making phone calls. You will not be doing admin work. You will be hunting for talent and messaging people every day.



WHAT WE OFFER THE PEOPLE YOU RECRUIT



You need to understand this so you can explain it with confidence:



Fully remote. They can work from anywhere in the US.

Free leads. They never have to buy their own.

Free training, proven scripts, morning team meetings, and daily new agent training.

Direct access to mentors who personally produce $100,000+ per month.

Newer agents on our team with zero sales experience are averaging around $8,000 a month, and some are making $10,000 to $15,000.

A real leadership path. This is not just a sales job. Agents who prove they can produce consistently get the opportunity to build and lead their own team, which is where the biggest income in this industry is made.

They must get licensed. They take the state life insurance exam, and once they pass, they start selling right away. We guide them through the process.



Be honest with every person you talk to: this is 100% commission. Nothing is guaranteed. Our agents work 8 to 12 hours a day, every day. This is for people who are serious about changing their financial situation and are willing to outwork everyone around them. We would rather have 10 hungry people than 100 people who quit after a week.



WHO YOU ARE LOOKING FOR



Must be 18 or older

Must live in the United States (any state)

Hungry, competitive, coachable, and motivated by money

Willing to get licensed and work full-time hours on commission

Age, background, and experience do not matter. Hunger does. Great fits include people in sales, retail, restaurants, customer service, car sales, real estate, ex-athletes, recent graduates, and anyone who has said “I want more out of my life.”



THE RECRUITING PROCESS (YOUR WORKFLOW)



Find: Search for candidates on Indeed,
 (groups, job posts, comments, profiles), LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, Reddit, Craigslist, and any other platform that works.

Message: Send personalized outreach from your own accounts using our approved scripts.

Pre-screen: Make sure they are in the US and genuinely interested before sending the video.

Send the video: Send every interested person our overview video, which explains the entire opportunity: 

Follow up: Confirm they watched the video and are still interested. Most people need several follow-ups. Do not let anyone go cold.

Qualify: Once they have watched the video and said yes, ask our qualifying questions by message (hours per day, location and time zone, age, willingness to get licensed, and their goals). Copy their answers into the tracking sheet.

Book: Book everyone who passes qualification on a call with me using my calendar link. If someone is especially motivated, book them as soon as possible.

Track: Log EVERY person you message in our tracking sheet the same day, with their name, profile link, platform, and current status. No exceptions. If it is not in the sheet, it did not happen.

Report: Send a short end-of-day report with your numbers: messages sent, replies, videos sent, videos watched, candidates qualified, and calls booked.



IMPORTANT: Read this full post carefully. To apply, the very first line of your application must be the words LIFE INSURANCE in all capital letters, followed by your full name. Applications that do not follow this instruction will be deleted without being read.



HOW YOU GET PAID



Hourly pay: $4 USD per hour, part-time, about 20 to 30 hours per week

Performance bonus: $150 USD for every person you recruit who joins my team, gets licensed, stays for at least 2 months, and submits at least $8,000 in business in a month. This is paid on top of your hourly pay.

There is no limit on bonuses. The more quality people you bring in, the more you can earn.

The first 2 weeks are a paid trial. If you hit your weekly target of 10 booked calls, the role becomes long-term.

Top performers will be considered for raises and more hours.



We reward people who bring in recruits who STAY and PRODUCE, not just people who say yes. Find people who are genuinely hungry, not people who will disappear in two weeks.



WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU



Part-time, about 20 to 30 hours per week, with at least some of your hours overlapping US daytime and evening hours (Pacific Time) when Americans are most likely to reply

Weekly target: a minimum of 10 new calls booked with me per week. Every booked call must be a qualified candidate who has watched the overview video and passed our qualifying questions. Missing this target consistently means the role is not a fit.

Excellent written English. Your messages must sound natural, friendly, and like a real American wrote them.

Self-motivated. Nobody will be standing over you. We look at results.

Organized. Every conversation you have must be logged in the tracking sheet with name, profile link, and status. Bonuses are only paid on recruits who are logged in the sheet.

Honest. Never promise anyone guaranteed income, never exaggerate what they will make, never lie about the job, and never spam people or break a platform’s rules. If your accounts get restricted, you cannot do the job.

Your own smartphone with active
, Instagram, and LinkedIn accounts, plus reliable internet and access to Google Sheets



REQUIREMENTS



Proven experience in recruiting, talent sourcing, lead generation, appointment setting, or social media outreach (required)

Experience finding people on
, Indeed, and LinkedIn (required)

Strong English writing skills (required)

Comfortable with Google Sheets

Experience recruiting for sales, insurance, real estate, or commission-based roles is a big plus and will move you to the top of the list



HOW TO APPLY



Follow the instruction from the middle of this post exactly. Then answer all of the following:



Describe your past recruiting, sourcing, or lead generation experience. What were you looking for, and what were your results (numbers)?

Write the exact first message you would send to a stranger on
 to see if they are interested in joining our team. Keep it short.

Someone replied “sounds interesting” three days ago but never watched the video you sent. Write the follow-up message you would send them.

Besides Indeed and
, name 3 places where you would find hungry people who want to make more money, and explain why.

How many outreach messages do you think you can realistically send in a 4 to 6 hour day while still keeping them personal?

Attach a 1 to 2 minute voice recording introducing yourself in English and explaining why you would be great at this job.

How many hours per week are you available, and which hours (Philippine time)?



Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.



If you are hungry yourself, competitive, and want a long-term job where your income grows with your results, we want to hear from you.

title: Appointment Setter
description:
LUXURY DAY SPA  |  WELLINGTON, NEW ZEALAND

Reservations Agent

Digital Advertising, Bookings & Spa Operations  |  Remote – Philippines

Position Reservations Agent (full-time)

Business Luxury day spa based in Wellington, New Zealand (business name disclosed at interview stage)

Location Remote – based in the Philippines (work from home)

Reports to Managing Director (MD)

Hours 45 hours per week, aligned to the spa's trading days (Tuesday – Saturday) 

Shifts run approximately 7:00am – 3:00pm Philippine time (moving by one hour seasonally). Exact roster to be confirmed.

Base salary PHP 22,000 per month

Weekly bonus An additional PHP 800, paid weekly, for every week that treatment revenue reaches $8,000 or more

Salary review After 6 months



About Us

We are a luxury day spa based in Wellington, New Zealand, offering a calm, contemporary escape with private treatment rooms, a steam room and a tranquil relaxation area. Our guests come to us to relax, rejuvenate and celebrate special occasions.

Our treatment menu includes luxury facials, relaxation and hot stone massages, body scrubs and wraps, hair therapy, foot rituals, pregnancy massage, and couples packages. We also offer midweek and seasonal specials, group bookings for birthdays and bridal showers, a membership program and gift vouchers.

About 95% of our clients are women, and they spend their time on TikTok, Instagram and
. Reaching them there, with beautiful and engaging content, is what fills our appointment book.



The Role

This is a hands-on, behind-the-scenes role that powers the whole business. You will create the advertising that makes the phone ring, turn those calls and
s into bookings in Zenoti, make sure our therapists deliver every treatment and are paid correctly, and then report on how the week performed so the next round of advertising is even better.

In short, you will be in charge of the full business cycle. It is a very interesting and rewarding role for a dedicated person who likes to see the direct result of their work, and when weekly treatment revenue reaches $8,000 or more, you share in that success with a weekly bonus.

The business cycle you will own



Why advertising comes first

Advertising is the engine of this role. Excellent, eye-catching content is what generates the calls and
s that become bookings. If the advertising is not done well, the calls and
s stop, and everything else in the cycle slows down. We are looking for someone who takes real ownership of this.

Key Responsibilities

1. Innovative AI advertising and content (the most important part of the role)

▪Zenoti marketing: run client campaigns and promotions through Zenoti's built-in marketing tools as the primary channel to our existing client base.

▪Paid social and search: plan, launch and manage ads across Meta 
 and Instagram, via Meta Business Suite / Ads Manager), TikTok, Google Ads and LinkedIn, within the budget agreed with the MD.

▪AI-powered creative: create innovative ads using AI tools for video, images, animation and copy, and connect AI video and animation platforms such as Higgsfield to produce scroll-stopping content.

▪Video library: build and keep a steady supply of attractive short-form videos (TikToks, Reels, Stories) showcasing our treatments, spa facilities, couples packages and current specials.

▪Know the audience: design every campaign for our core audience of women, with a strong focus on TikTok, Instagram and
.

▪Promote what sells: push midweek and seasonal specials, group and celebration bookings, gift vouchers and our membership program.

▪Measure and improve: track reach, enquiries, cost per booking and revenue from each campaign, and use those results to improve the next round of content.

2. Customer enquiries – phone and

▪Answer customer phone calls and
s promptly, warmly and professionally, in excellent English.

▪Advise customers on treatments, packages, pricing, availability, gift vouchers and spa policies, including the cancellation and rescheduling policy.

▪Turn enquiries into confirmed bookings and follow up on enquiries that have not yet booked.

3. Appointment setting in Zenoti

▪Create, reschedule and cancel appointments in Zenoti, matching each booking to available therapists and treatment rooms.

▪Fill the appointment book efficiently to make the most of therapist time and our treatment rooms.

▪Keep client records, notes and contact details accurate and up to date.

4. Staff coordination and treatment completion

▪Maintain close, daily communication with therapists and spa staff on WhatsApp about bookings, changes and customer queries.

▪Make sure every booked appointment goes ahead as planned and resolve any issues quickly.

▪Once a treatment is finished, confirm that payment has been taken and the appointment is correctly closed off in Zenoti.

5. Staff timesheet approval

▪Approve staff timesheets in line with the Sign-In and Sign-Off Procedure document, so staff are paid correctly and on time.

▪Identify and flag any missing sign-ins, sign-offs or discrepancies to the MD before approval.

6. Recruitment and training coordination

▪Advertise open positions for spa staff on job boards and manage incoming applications.

▪Schedule and coordinate training sessions with therapists.

7. Reporting and business performance

▪Run sales and treatment revenue reports in Zenoti and track weekly revenue against the $8,000 target.

▪Update the cash-up reporting every Saturday.

▪Update the weekly PowerPoint report and present it to the MD.

▪Share insights on what is working, and feed them back into the next advertising campaigns.

How Success Is Measured

▪Weekly treatment revenue, with a target of $8,000 or more

▪Number of calls and
s generated by advertising

▪Enquiry-to-booking conversion rate and speed of response to customers

▪Consistent, high-quality content and ads posted to an agreed schedule

▪Payment confirmed for every completed treatment

▪Accurate timesheets, cash-up reports and on-time Saturday reporting to the MD



About You

Must have

▪Excellent English speaking and writing skills. This is essential: you will be the voice of a luxury day spa on the phone and in writing.

▪Proven experience creating social media content and running paid ads on Meta, TikTok and/or Google Ads.

▪Hands-on experience with AI tools for video, image and copy creation, and a genuine passion for creative, innovative content.

▪Customer service experience by phone and
, ideally with New Zealand or other international customers.

▪Highly organised, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage many tasks at once.

▪Confident with Excel or Google Sheets and PowerPoint, and comfortable presenting results.

▪A professional work-from-home setup, including:

–A stable, high-speed internet connection

–A calm, quiet working environment with no background noise

–A good-quality PC or laptop

–A good-quality headset with a clear microphone, so your voice is clear on every call

–An uninterrupted power supply (UPS) and a power backup for outages

Nice to have

▪Experience with Zenoti or another spa or salon booking system (such as Fresha, Mindbody or Timely).

▪Background in a spa, beauty, wellness or hospitality business.

▪Video editing skills (for example CapCut or Canva) and LinkedIn advertising experience.

▪Experience with recruitment advertising or staff scheduling.

Personal qualities

▪Dedicated, self-motivated and takes ownership of results

▪Creative, curious and quick to try new AI tools and ideas

▪Warm, professional and calm with customers and staff

▪Commercially minded: you care about bookings and revenue, not just likes

Why You Will Love This Role

▪You run the full business cycle, from the first ad to the final report, and see the direct impact of your work every week.

▪Creative freedom to experiment with the latest AI advertising and video tools.

▪A weekly bonus that rewards you when the spa does well.

▪Work closely with the MD of a luxury day spa in New Zealand.

How to Apply

Please apply through this job listing and include:

▪Your CV

▪A short cover letter in English explaining why you are right for this role

▪Links to ads, videos or social media content you have created (AI-generated work especially welcome)

▪A 1 – 2 minute voice or video recording introducing yourself in English

title: CRO Lead - Shopify Landing Pages & Funnel Optimization
description:
**Remote · Full-time · Independent Contractor · Flexible, output-based**



### About us



We are a fast-growing children’s supplements brand built around a simple purpose: helping parents support their children’s everyday wellbeing. We serve families primarily in the United States through our online store and care about the experience beyond the sale—from how we communicate with parents to how reliably their orders arrive.



We’re looking for a **CRO Manager** to establish and run a systematic conversion-rate-optimization program for paid-acquisition landing pages and the customer journey that follows. You’ll help us improve purchase conversion and revenue per visitor while protecting margin, customer understanding, and subscription quality.



### What You’ll Own



You’ll own the CRO process from research and prioritization through build, QA, launch, analysis, rollout, and documentation. You’ll work closely with Creative Strategists and coordinate with Meta campaign owners, development, customer experience, finance, operations, and lifecycle partners as needed.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Analyze Shopify performance, funnel behavior, customer feedback, support themes, session recordings, and other relevant evidence to identify conversion opportunities.

- Maintain a prioritized testing backlog with a clear problem, hypothesis, audience, primary metric, guardrails, and decision rule for each test.

- Independently build, edit, and optimize Shopify landing pages and straightforward funnel changes using the agreed tools; coordinate specialist development when custom implementation is needed.

- Align landing-page formats, positioning, messaging, proof, objection handling, and calls to action with paid Meta creative and customer intent.

- Own tests through implementation, QA, launch, monitoring, analysis, and supported-winner rollout.

- Validate assignment, conversion events, tracking, links, pricing, discounts, subscription behavior, and mobile/desktop functionality before launch.

- Classify results honestly as winning, losing, or inconclusive and maintain concise weekly updates on tests, learnings, priorities, blockers, and decisions.



### What Success Looks Like



During your first 90 days, you will:



- **Days 1–30:** Audit priority paid-traffic journeys, establish baseline CVR, revenue per visitor, AOV, and funnel metrics where data allows, document measurement gaps, deliver a prioritized roadmap, and launch the first experiment subject to access and implementation capacity.

- **Days 31–60:** Manage a repeatable experimentation cycle with a rolling backlog, documented hypotheses and QA, consistent reporting, clear blocker ownership, and supported-winner decisions.

- **Days 61–90:** Demonstrate credible commercial learning and progress through documented results, uncertainty, next decisions, and implementation of supported winners within agreed guardrails.



Ongoing success will be assessed through experiment quality and delivery, purchase conversion rate, revenue per visitor, funnel progression, AOV, and agreed margin, refund, subscription, and customer-experience guardrails. Fixed uplift targets will be set after baseline validation; test count or win rate alone will not define success.



### What You Bring



- Proven hands-on CRO experience with Shopify DTC or direct-response brands acquiring customers through Meta.

- Evidence that you personally owned the full testing cycle, not only advised or supervised an agency.

- Case studies explaining what you analyzed, what you implemented, how the test or comparison was designed, the primary metric, the result, uncertainty or limitations, and what happened next.

- Strong understanding of direct-response messaging, ad-to-landing-page consistency, mobile UX, customer psychology, objections, and purchase friction.

- Practical experimentation knowledge, including traffic allocation, sample-size considerations, stopping rules, and interpreting inconclusive results.

- Working knowledge of Shopify Analytics, GA4 or equivalent, Clarity or Hotjar, and an experimentation platform such as Intelligems, Shoplift, VWO, or equivalent.

- Ability to build or modify landing pages in the agreed stack, perform implementation QA, investigate tracking inconsistencies, and coordinate fixes.

- Clear written English, concise reporting, independent follow-through, and sound customer and commercial judgment.



**Useful, but not required:** Subscription DTC, supplements, skincare, or parent-focused product experience; testing bundles, pricing, subscription offers, post-purchase upsells, cohorts, or retention; direct-response copywriting and wireframing; HTML/CSS/JavaScript or Shopify Liquid; international-market experience; and sensible use of AI with output validation.



We’re interested in evidence of what you can do. Your application should show relevant CRO case studies, work samples, or examples and explain what you personally owned.



### How We Work



You’ll report to the **Founder** for commercial direction, strategic alignment, performance, and major approvals. Operations provides delivery visibility, cross-functional coordination, dependency support, and escalation of operational blockers.



Within the agreed roadmap, you can prioritize routine tests, develop hypotheses, coordinate briefs, run analysis, and recommend or implement supported winners. Product claims, pricing, discount limits, subscription terms, material spending, major site functionality, and other commercial or customer commitments require approval.



**Working arrangement:** Full-time, remote, independent contractor, and output-based with a flexible schedule. Required overlap with the Founder and Creative Strategists is encouraged; the Founder’s active times are GST.



### Why Work With Us



- Have an autonomy to run and own CRO function in a fast growing DTC eCommerce brand

- Work directly with the founder, Creative Strategists and the teams responsible for customer experience and commercial performance.

- Have meaningful autonomy within clear priorities, quality standards, and approval boundaries.

- Work remotely in a flexible, output-focused environment. No micromanagement.



### Hiring Process



1. Application review

2. Interview with Operations Lead

3. Paid trial, TBD

4. Final interview and approval with Founder

5. Offer and onboarding



### How to Apply



**Apply through our company form:** 



Please include relevant case studies or work samples and explain what you analyzed, implemented, measured, and learned. We look forward to reviewing your application.



Sounds like you? Submit your application now. Take note: we only accept applications via our company link. Thanks!
